lede.zh: 共同外护套主干在两端展开为多种端头，光连接与电连接的配置应分别定义。
lede.en: A common jacketed trunk breaks out to several end forms at both ends. Define the optical and electrical connections separately.

quickPoints.zh: 项目范围与验收先行确认
quickPoints.en: Define scope and acceptance before sampling

structureIntro.zh: 组合端头用于讨论不同连接路径的共同布置。光通道、电源与其他信号的功能及验收分别定义，不凭组合外形推断光电转换。
structureIntro.en: The combined ends provide a starting point for routing different connection paths together. Define optical, power and other signal functions and acceptance separately; a combined form does not establish optical-electrical conversion.

value.zh: 分别记录两端接头系列、对插件与端面形式；接口名称相近不能替代完整型号和配线端口资料。
value.en: Record each connector series, mating part and end-face form. Similar interface names do not replace complete part numbers and distribution-port documents.

value.zh: 把光纤类型与通道数、电源负载及其他信号路径分开列入连接表；共同护套不表示不同路径共用接点。
value.en: List fiber type and channel count, power loads and other signal paths separately. Sharing a jacket does not mean the paths share contacts.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。
value.en: Define the position and transmit/receive relationship at both ends of every fiber. Include polarity or breakout maps for multifiber and branched assemblies.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 围绕光纤弯曲边界、电路绝缘要求和各端头固定位置安排主干与分支，分别确认护套、屏蔽和应力支撑。
value.en: Arrange trunks and breakouts around fiber bending limits, electrical insulation and end retention. Define jackets, shielding and strain support for their respective paths.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.zh: 光模块侧的独立光通道
title.en: Separate optical paths at optical modules

text.zh: 混合连接项目在光模块侧分别确认光接口、通道和设备端跳线，独立电源或其他信号按各自连接表布置。共同护套与分支结构不表示光通道和电路共用接点，也不等于自带光电转换。
text.en: In a mixed-connection project, define optical interfaces, channels and equipment-side jumpers at the optical module separately. Route independent power or other signals from their own maps. Shared jackets and breakouts do not establish shared contacts or built-in optical-electrical conversion.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 机柜内模块使用不同接口时，可在装配图中统一安排端头位置与标签。光通道、电源及其他信号仍各有对应表，安装人员能够逐路核对连接用途。
text.en: When cabinet modules use different interfaces, coordinate end positions and labels in one assembly drawing. Retain separate maps for optical channels, power and other signals so each connection purpose can be checked during installation.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

title.en: Separate optical and electrical interface maps

text.zh: 以设备资料分别建立光通道映射、电源或其他信号连接表，明确各端头用途，再整理为统一的装配图与标识方案。
text.en: Create optical-channel and power or other signal maps from equipment documents. Define each end function before combining them in an assembly drawing and identification plan.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 混合端头是否表示线缆自带光电转换？
question.en: Do mixed ends establish built-in optical-electrical conversion?

answer.zh: 不能这样判断。需要设备功能框图与电路资料确认各接口用途；如果项目含有源转换模块，其供电、协议和验证范围必须另行定义。
answer.en: They do not. Equipment block diagrams and circuit documents must establish the interface functions. If the project includes an active conversion module, define its supply, protocol and validation scope separately.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供设备功能框图、光接口和通道表、电源或其他信号连接表，以及主干与分支尺寸，明确混合连接的装配和验证边界。
text.en: Share the equipment block diagram, optical interfaces and channel map, power or other signal maps, and trunk and branch dimensions to define the mixed assembly and validation scope.

text.zh: 组件以转接或组合形式组织连接，可围绕两端设备位置安排端头方向、过渡段与固定。
text.en: The assembly organizes a transition or combined connection, with end directions, transition sections and fixing arranged around the equipment positions.

text.zh: 端头采用插接形式，可围绕安装位置安排插入、退出及线缆弯曲空间。
text.en: The end uses a plug-in form, with clearance arranged for insertion, removal and cable bends.

text.zh: 多个端头提供分别接入的位置，线束展开方向与各端头间距可围绕模块布局定义。
text.en: Multiple ends provide separate connection positions. Layout and spacing can follow the module arrangement.

text.zh: 光接口与电接口的端头、连接表和验收依据分别确认，再统一安排主干、分支与标识。
text.en: Confirm optical and electrical ends, maps and acceptance references separately, then coordinate the trunk, branches and labels.

category.zh: 光纤与电连接组合组件

lede.zh: 彩色细线从集中段展开为多路独立端头，适合讨论分支整理、编号与接入顺序。
lede.en: Fine colored leads fan out from a gathered section to multiple separate ends. Branch organization, identification and connection order are the central layout questions.

quickPoints.zh: 按项目定义端接与验收

structureIntro.zh: 从端头、主干和接入位置理解这一连接形式，光接口、通道对应与布线尺寸按项目资料确认。
structureIntro.en: Review this connection form through its ends, trunk and entry positions. Define optical interfaces, channel mapping and routing dimensions from project documents.

value.zh: 分别记录两端接头系列、对插件与端面形式；接口名称相近不能替代完整型号和配线端口资料。
value.en: Record each connector series, mating part and end-face form. Similar interface names do not replace complete part numbers and distribution-port documents.

value.zh: 按设备光模块与布线方案确认单模或多模、纤芯规格及实际通道数；展示颜色不能作为纤型依据。
value.en: Confirm single-mode or multimode construction, fiber specification and channel count from the optical modules and cabling plan. Display colors do not establish fiber type.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。

value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 结合室内外位置、外径、安装弯曲和拉力要求选择护套与保护结构；无卤、阻燃等材料要求单独提供文件依据。
value.en: Select the jacket and protection around location, diameter, installation bends and pulling limits. Supply separate evidence for any halogen-free or flame-performance requirement.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。设备端跳线与主干或分支端头分别核对系列、端面和通道，不由相似外形推断对插。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Check the series, end faces and channels of equipment jumpers and trunk or breakout ends separately; similar outlines do not establish mating.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。MPO等集中接口通过指定配线结构与设备端跳线对应，不默认直接对插LC光口。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Map concentrated interfaces such as MPO through the specified distribution structure and equipment jumpers; do not assume direct mating to an LC optical port.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: MPO多芯连接如何确认通道顺序？
question.en: How is channel order defined in a multifiber MPO link?

answer.zh: 使用两端端口视图定义光纤位置、收发方向与极性，确认MPO定位和对插要求，再把对应关系写入装配及验收文件。
answer.en: Use end-port views to define fiber positions, transmit/receive direction and polarity. Confirm MPO alignment and mating requirements, then include the map in assembly and acceptance documents.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供两端设备接口、光纤类型、通道对应、目标长度及所需验收文件，先明确物料、端接和项目验证的范围。
text.en: Share equipment interfaces at both ends, fiber type, channel mapping, target lengths and acceptance documents to define materials, termination and project-validation scope.

text.zh: 双端MPO形式端头配合一条连续线段，端头方向与机架间走线路径共同决定安装布局。
text.en: MPO-form ends sit on a continuous cable section. End orientation and the route between rack positions determine the installation layout.

text.zh: 以两端端口图、通道对应、尺寸基准和样品版本确认装配要求，便于安装核对与后续供货保持一致。
text.en: Use end-port drawings, channel mapping, dimensional datums and the sample revision to define assembly requirements for installation checks and consistent repeat supply.

text.zh: 以两端端口视图建立通道对应，连接器系列、端面形式与收发方向分别记录。
text.en: Create channel mapping from end-port views, recording connector series, end-face form and transmit/receive direction separately.

lede.zh: 一端集中、另一端展开为多路细支线的结构，将干线连接与设备端分配组合在同一组件中。
lede.en: A gathered end opens into several fine branches at the other end, combining a trunk connection with separate equipment-side takeoffs.

quickPoints.zh: 按项目定义端接与验收

structureIntro.zh: 从端头、主干和接入位置理解这一连接形式，光接口、通道对应与布线尺寸按项目资料确认。
structureIntro.en: Review this connection form through its ends, trunk and entry positions. Define optical interfaces, channel mapping and routing dimensions from project documents.

value.zh: 分别核对MPO接点布局、定位结构及对端接口；如有LC分支，逐路列出对应端头与标签。
value.en: Check the MPO position layout, alignment arrangement and mating interface. Where LC breakouts are used, list each branch end and label.

value.zh: 按设备光模块与布线方案确认单模或多模、纤芯规格及实际通道数；展示颜色不能作为纤型依据。
value.en: Confirm single-mode or multimode construction, fiber specification and channel count from the optical modules and cabling plan. Display colors do not establish fiber type.

value.zh: 用端口视图明确MPO各位置与另一端的通道关系，约定极性、收发方向和分支排序，不把外形当作固定极性。
value.en: Use port views to map MPO positions to channels at the other end. Specify polarity, transmit/receive direction and branch order; outline does not establish polarity.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 结合室内外位置、外径、安装弯曲和拉力要求选择护套与保护结构；无卤、阻燃等材料要求单独提供文件依据。
value.en: Select the jacket and protection around location, diameter, installation bends and pulling limits. Supply separate evidence for any halogen-free or flame-performance requirement.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供两端设备接口、光纤类型、通道对应、目标长度及所需验收文件，先明确物料、端接和项目验证的范围。
text.en: Share equipment interfaces at both ends, fiber type, channel mapping, target lengths and acceptance documents to define materials, termination and project-validation scope.

text.zh: 组件以转接或组合形式组织连接，可围绕两端设备位置安排端头方向、过渡段与固定。
text.en: The assembly organizes a transition or combined connection, with end directions, transition sections and fixing arranged around the equipment positions.

text.zh: 连接以主干布线形式组织，可围绕设备固定基准安排整体走向、端头位置和可拆卸余量。
text.en: The connections follow a main-trunk form, with the overall route, end positions and service allowance arranged around equipment datums.

text.zh: 两端端口编号与通道对应使用同一份连接表；分支端头另按去向标识，方便安装和检修核对。
text.en: Use one connection map for end-port IDs and channel correspondence. Identify breakout ends by destination for installation and service checks.

text.zh: 外护套主干与端部细尾的过渡位置需要结合安装路径安排支撑，细尾段保留各接头独立操作的空间。
text.en: Support the transition between the jacketed trunk and fine tails around the installation route. Leave room to handle each connector independently.

lede.zh: 连续外护套主干两端设独立连接位置，端部细线段为接入和维护预留了布置空间。
lede.en: A continuous jacketed trunk has connection positions at both ends. The finer end sections provide space for connection and servicing.

quickPoints.zh: 按项目定义端接与验收

structureIntro.zh: 从端头、主干和接入位置理解这一连接形式，光接口、通道对应与布线尺寸按项目资料确认。
structureIntro.en: Review this connection form through its ends, trunk and entry positions. Define optical interfaces, channel mapping and routing dimensions from project documents.

value.zh: 分别记录两端接头系列、对插件与端面形式；接口名称相近不能替代完整型号和配线端口资料。
value.en: Record each connector series, mating part and end-face form. Similar interface names do not replace complete part numbers and distribution-port documents.

value.zh: 按设备光模块与布线方案确认单模或多模、纤芯规格及实际通道数；展示颜色不能作为纤型依据。
value.en: Confirm single-mode or multimode construction, fiber specification and channel count from the optical modules and cabling plan. Display colors do not establish fiber type.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。
value.en: Define the position and transmit/receive relationship at both ends of every fiber. Include polarity or breakout maps for multifiber and branched assemblies.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 结合室内外位置、外径、安装弯曲和拉力要求选择护套与保护结构；无卤、阻燃等材料要求单独提供文件依据。
value.en: Select the jacket and protection around location, diameter, installation bends and pulling limits. Supply separate evidence for any halogen-free or flame-performance requirement.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。设备端跳线与主干或分支端头分别核对系列、端面和通道，不由相似外形推断对插。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Check the series, end faces and channels of equipment jumpers and trunk or breakout ends separately; similar outlines do not establish mating.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。
value.en: Define the position and transmit/receive relationship at both ends of every fiber. Include polarity or breakout maps for multifiber and branched assemblies.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 结合室内外位置、外径、安装弯曲和拉力要求选择护套与保护结构；无卤、阻燃等材料要求单独提供文件依据。
value.en: Select the jacket and protection around location, diameter, installation bends and pulling limits. Supply separate evidence for any halogen-free or flame-performance requirement.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。设备端跳线与主干或分支端头分别核对系列、端面和通道，不由相似外形推断对插。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Check the series, end faces and channels of equipment jumpers and trunk or breakout ends separately; similar outlines do not establish mating.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始

text.zh: 提供两端设备接口、光纤类型、通道对应、目标长度及所需验收文件，先明确物料、端接和项目验证的范围。
text.en: Share equipment interfaces at both ends, fiber type, channel mapping, target lengths and acceptance documents to define materials, termination and project-validation scope.

text.zh: 细径跳接线与成对LC形式端头组合，端头次序和收纳弯曲空间是安装布局的重点。
text.en: Fine jumper leads are combined with paired LC-form ends. End order and space for stored cable bends are key installation considerations.

text.zh: 以两端端口图、通道对应、尺寸基准和样品版本确认装配要求，便于安装核对与后续供货保持一致。
text.en: Use end-port drawings, channel mapping, dimensional datums and the sample revision to define assembly requirements for installation checks and consistent repeat supply.

text.zh: 以两端端口视图建立通道对应，连接器系列、端面形式与收发方向分别记录。
text.en: Create channel mapping from end-port views, recording connector series, end-face form and transmit/receive direction separately.

lede.zh: LC形式端头带便于抓取的外部结构，密集端口区域需同时预留操作和出线空间。
lede.en: LC-form ends have an extended gripping structure. Dense port areas need clearance for both handling and cable exit.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供两端设备接口、光纤类型、通道对应、目标长度及所需验收文件，先明确物料、端接和项目验证的范围。
text.en: Share equipment interfaces at both ends, fiber type, channel mapping, target lengths and acceptance documents to define materials, termination and project-validation scope.

text.zh: 双端ST形式连接与细径跳接线组成点对点结构，可按设备间距安排长度与接入方向。
text.en: ST-form connections at both ends form a point-to-point jumper. Cable length and entry direction can follow the equipment spacing.

text.zh: 以两端端口图、通道对应、尺寸基准和样品版本确认装配要求，便于安装核对与后续供货保持一致。
text.en: Use end-port drawings, channel mapping, dimensional datums and the sample revision to define assembly requirements for installation checks and consistent repeat supply.

text.zh: 以两端端口视图建立通道对应，连接器系列、端面形式与收发方向分别记录。
text.en: Create channel mapping from end-port views, recording connector series, end-face form and transmit/receive direction separately.

lede.zh: 共同外护套主干与多路独立端头组合，光通道与电源支路需要各自的连接表和检验依据。
lede.en: A common jacketed trunk is combined with multiple separate ends. Optical channels and power branches need their own connection maps and acceptance references.

quickPoints.zh: 项目范围与验收先行确认
quickPoints.en: Define scope and acceptance before sampling

structureIntro.zh: 组合端头用于讨论不同连接路径的共同布置。光通道、电源与其他信号的功能及验收分别定义，不凭组合外形推断光电转换。
structureIntro.en: The combined ends provide a starting point for routing different connection paths together. Define optical, power and other signal functions and acceptance separately; a combined form does not establish optical-electrical conversion.

value.zh: 分别记录两端接头系列、对插件与端面形式；接口名称相近不能替代完整型号和配线端口资料。
value.en: Record each connector series, mating part and end-face form. Similar interface names do not replace complete part numbers and distribution-port documents.

value.zh: 把光纤类型与通道数、电源负载及其他信号路径分开列入连接表；共同护套不表示不同路径共用接点。
value.en: List fiber type and channel count, power loads and other signal paths separately. Sharing a jacket does not mean the paths share contacts.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。
value.en: Define the position and transmit/receive relationship at both ends of every fiber. Include polarity or breakout maps for multifiber and branched assemblies.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 围绕光纤弯曲边界、电路绝缘要求和各端头固定位置安排主干与分支，分别确认护套、屏蔽和应力支撑。
value.en: Arrange trunks and breakouts around fiber bending limits, electrical insulation and end retention. Define jackets, shielding and strain support for their respective paths.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.zh: 光模块侧的独立光通道
title.en: Separate optical paths at optical modules

text.zh: 混合连接项目在光模块侧分别确认光接口、通道和设备端跳线，独立电源或其他信号按各自连接表布置。共同护套与分支结构不表示光通道和电路共用接点，也不等于自带光电转换。
text.en: In a mixed-connection project, define optical interfaces, channels and equipment-side jumpers at the optical module separately. Route independent power or other signals from their own maps. Shared jackets and breakouts do not establish shared contacts or built-in optical-electrical conversion.

text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 机柜内模块使用不同接口时，可在装配图中统一安排端头位置与标签。光通道、电源及其他信号仍各有对应表，安装人员能够逐路核对连接用途。
text.en: When cabinet modules use different interfaces, coordinate end positions and labels in one assembly drawing. Retain separate maps for optical channels, power and other signals so each connection purpose can be checked during installation.

text.en: Create optical-channel and power or other signal maps from equipment documents. Define each end function before combining them in an assembly drawing and identification plan.

text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

answer.zh: 不能这样判断。需要设备功能框图与电路资料确认各接口用途；如果项目含有源转换模块，其供电、协议和验证范围必须另行定义。

answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

text.en: Share the equipment block diagram, optical interfaces and channel map, power or other signal maps, and trunk and branch dimensions to define the mixed assembly and validation scope.

text.zh: 多个端头提供分别接入的位置，线束展开方向与各端头间距可围绕模块布局定义。

text.zh: 光接口与电接口的端头、连接表和验收依据分别确认，再统一安排主干、分支与标识。

value.en: Confirm LC channel positions, fiber type and the remote equipment requirements. USB contacts are not a direct contact map for optical channels.

text.en: Combined connections around optical modules need defined module interfaces, auxiliary supply and responsibility for each cable section. Review the sample layout and functional documents before defining optical and electrical acceptance within the complete system plan.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供设备功能框图、光接口和通道表、电源或其他信号连接表，以及主干与分支尺寸，明确混合连接的装配和验证边界。
text.en: Share the equipment block diagram, optical interfaces and channel map, power or other signal maps, and trunk and branch dimensions to define the mixed assembly and validation scope.

text.zh: USB形式的端头可作为设备接入边界，端头朝向与引线走向按安装空间布置。
text.en: The USB-form end provides a device connection boundary, with end orientation and lead routing arranged for the installation space.

text.zh: 组件以转接或组合形式组织连接，可围绕两端设备位置安排端头方向、过渡段与固定。
text.en: The assembly organizes a transition or combined connection, with end directions, transition sections and fixing arranged around the equipment positions.

text.zh: 光接口与电接口的端头、连接表和验收依据分别确认，再统一安排主干、分支与标识。
text.en: Confirm optical and electrical ends, maps and acceptance references separately, then coordinate the trunk, branches and labels.

title.en: Mixed Cable with USB and LC Interfaces

category.zh: 光纤与电连接组合组件

lede.zh: 白色跳接线两端设不同颜色的SC形式端头，APC与UPC的端面和对插要求需分别核对。
lede.en: A white jumper has differently colored SC-form ends. Check the end-face and mating requirements for APC and UPC separately.

quickPoints.zh: 按项目定义端接与验收

structureIntro.zh: 从端头、主干和接入位置理解这一连接形式，光接口、通道对应与布线尺寸按项目资料确认。
structureIntro.en: Review this connection form through its ends, trunk and entry positions. Define optical interfaces, channel mapping and routing dimensions from project documents.

value.zh: 逐端定义SC/APC或SC/UPC及其对插件。APC与UPC要求按端口分开记录，不把不同端面直接作为同一种对插连接。
value.en: Define SC/APC or SC/UPC and the mating part at each end. Record APC and UPC requirements per port; different end faces are not one interchangeable mating connection.

value.zh: 按设备光模块与布线方案确认单模或多模、纤芯规格及实际通道数；展示颜色不能作为纤型依据。
value.en: Confirm single-mode or multimode construction, fiber specification and channel count from the optical modules and cabling plan. Display colors do not establish fiber type.

value.zh: 定义每根光纤两端的位置及收发对应。多芯与分支组件另附极性或分支映射图，避免按外形默认接续顺序。
value.en: Define the position and transmit/receive relationship at both ends of every fiber. Include polarity or breakout maps for multifiber and branched assemblies.

value.zh: 明确总长、端部细尾段或各支路的测量起止点、公差及标识位置，并保留设备插拔所需余量。
value.en: Define measurement points, tolerances and identification positions for the overall cable, fine tails or individual branches. Allow enough length for equipment mating and removal.

value.zh: 结合室内外位置、外径、安装弯曲和拉力要求选择护套与保护结构；无卤、阻燃等材料要求单独提供文件依据。
value.en: Select the jacket and protection around location, diameter, installation bends and pulling limits. Supply separate evidence for any halogen-free or flame-performance requirement.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。设备端跳线与主干或分支端头分别核对系列、端面和通道，不由相似外形推断对插。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Check the series, end faces and channels of equipment jumpers and trunk or breakout ends separately; similar outlines do not establish mating.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

value.zh: 在项目开始时约定端面清洁、通道核对及所需光学测试条件、限值和报告责任，并对应所选接口与光缆配置。
value.en: Agree end-face cleanliness, channel checks and any required optical test conditions, limits and reporting responsibility at project start for the selected interface and cable configuration.

text.zh: 光配线面板的跳接需按端口位置安排端头方向、尾套空间与可拆卸余量。接头系列、端面形式和通道编号与配线记录一起确认。
text.en: At fiber-distribution panels, arrange connector orientation, boot clearance and service allowance around port positions. Confirm the connector series, end-face form and channel identification against the distribution record before defining each jumper.

text.zh: 设备光口与配线侧之间的短距离连接，重点是端头对插、发送接收方向和弯曲空间。通道对应以设备端口资料为准，不用外壳颜色推断。
text.en: For short links between equipment optical ports and the distribution side, review mating ends, transmit/receive direction and bend clearance. Use equipment-port documents to establish channel mapping rather than inferring it from housing colors.

title.en: Rack optical ports and distribution transitions

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。设备端跳线与主干或分支端头分别核对系列、端面和通道，不由相似外形推断对插。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. Check the series, end faces and channels of equipment jumpers and trunk or breakout ends separately; similar outlines do not establish mating.

text.zh: 竖向布线路径需要为转弯、固定和维护留出空间。按所选光缆规定弯曲与拉力边界，并将余长收纳位置与设备风道、可拆模块分开安排。
text.en: Vertical cabinet routes need space for turns, supports and servicing. Use the selected optical cable documents to set bending and tensile limits, and keep stored slack separate from equipment airflow and removable-module access.

text.zh: 多模块连接可通过端头编号、支路长度和端口分组减少安装时的查线工作。分支组件需单独记录每路去向；双端跳线则明确对应的设备与配线位置。
text.en: Identify ends, branch lengths and port groups to simplify connections across equipment modules. Record every destination for breakout assemblies; for two-ended jumpers, identify the corresponding equipment and distribution positions in the installation documents.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 采用光接口的视频机房项目，可结合设备机架、配线面板和维修通道安排跳接。光模块、信号制式和链路验收按系统要求确定，线缆外形不代表视频格式支持。
text.en: For video-room projects that specify optical interfaces, plan jumpers around equipment racks, distribution panels and service aisles. Establish optical-module selection, signal format and link acceptance from system requirements; cable form alone does not establish video-format support.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备与配线路径展开。所选光接口、通道及光学验收要求以具体系统资料为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions cover equipment connections and distribution routes. Define optical interfaces, channels and optical acceptance from the specific system documents.

text.zh: 把设备端口表整理为接头组合、通道对应和端头编号，分支或多芯结构同时明确极性与展开方向。
text.en: Turn equipment-port records into a connector combination, channel map and end-identification plan. Define polarity and breakout orientation for branched or multifiber structures.

text.zh: 围绕机架路径调整总长、细尾长度、分支位置和护套段落，并把固定、弯曲与维护余量写入确认图。
text.en: Set overall length, fine-tail length, breakout positions and jacket sections around the rack route. Include supports, bending limits and service allowance in the approval drawing.

text.zh: 样品阶段分别确认接口装配、通道资料和安装尺寸；光纤端接方式、光学测试与报告要求按项目商定范围执行。
text.en: Use the sample stage to review interface assembly, channel records and installed dimensions. Agree the scope for optical termination, optical testing and reports on the specific project.

question.zh: 同一种外形的光接头可以直接混插吗？
question.en: Can optical connectors with the same outline be intermated?

answer.zh: 需同时核对系列、对插件、光纤类型与端面形式。尤其APC与UPC端面要求不同，不能仅凭SC或LC名称确认连接。
answer.en: Check the series, mating part, fiber type and end-face form together. APC and UPC have different end-face requirements; an SC or LC name alone does not establish a mating combination.

question.zh: 多芯或双芯组件如何避免通道接反？
question.en: How are channels kept in the correct order?

answer.zh: 用两端端口视图、收发定义及通道编号建立映射。MPO或分支结构还需约定极性与分支排序，并在项目验收记录中体现。
answer.en: Create a map from end-port views, transmit/receive definitions and channel IDs. For MPO or breakout structures, also specify polarity and branch order in the acceptance records.

question.zh: 需要哪些资料才能确认光学验收？
question.en: What defines optical acceptance for a project?

answer.zh: 提供所选纤型、接头与端面要求，以及系统规定的测试波长、限值和报告要求。端接、检测与报告的执行责任在样品前确认。
answer.en: Provide the fiber type, connector and end-face requirements, plus the system-defined test wavelengths, limits and reporting requirements. Confirm responsibility for termination, testing and reports before sampling.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 电连接与组合项目支持
title.en: China factory · electrical and combined-project support

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造与OEM/ODM项目支持。涉及光连接的组合需求，分别确认电连接制造、光纤物料与端接、安装装配及光学验收的执行范围，再确定样品方案与交付文件。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. For projects involving optical connections, define electrical manufacture, optical materials and termination, installation assembly and optical acceptance as separate scopes before agreeing samples and delivery documents.

title.zh: 从光接口与布线路径开始
title.en: Start with optical interfaces and the routing plan

text.zh: 提供两端设备接口、光纤类型、通道对应、目标长度及所需验收文件，先明确物料、端接和项目验证的范围。
text.en: Share equipment interfaces at both ends, fiber type, channel mapping, target lengths and acceptance documents to define materials, termination and project-validation scope.

text.zh: 两路细线分别接入LC与SC形式端头，成对通道的方向、编号与长度需要同步安排。
text.en: Two fine leads connect LC- and SC-form ends. Coordinate direction, identification and length across the paired channels.

text.zh: 两端端口编号与通道对应使用同一份连接表；分支端头另按去向标识，方便安装和检修核对。
text.en: Use one connection map for end-port IDs and channel correspondence. Identify breakout ends by destination for installation and service checks.

text.zh: 以设备间距、接头朝向和所选线缆的弯曲要求安排总长与端部余量，固定位置避开接头尾套。
text.en: Set overall length and end allowance from equipment spacing, connector direction and the selected cable bending requirements. Place supports clear of connector boots.

lede.zh: 多路网络形式端头与集中线段组合，可围绕设备端口分组安排支路长度、线号与安装顺序。线序和实际承载任务需按设备连接表定义。
lede.en: Multiple network-form ends are combined with a gathered cable section. Branch lengths, labels and installation order can follow equipment port groups, with wiring and the actual task defined by the equipment connection map.

quickPoints.zh: 传输与供电按项目确认

structureIntro.zh: 先看端头形式与支路安排，再用设备端口表明确各路连接用途。铜缆的线对、屏蔽与供电要求分开定义。
structureIntro.en: Review end forms and branch arrangement, then use equipment-port records to define each connection task. Specify copper pairs, shielding and supply requirements separately.

value.zh: 记录RJ45或RJ21等端头的完整形式、端口资料、锁扣与安装方向；屏蔽壳体和普通壳体分别确认。
value.en: Record the complete RJ45, RJ21 or other end form, port documents, latch and installation direction. Confirm shielded and unshielded housing configurations separately.

value.zh: 确定逐针对应、线对分配、直通或交叉关系。多路组件需要每个端口与主接口的完整对应表。
value.en: Define contact mapping, pair allocation and straight-through or crossover connections. Multiway assemblies need a complete map between every branch port and the main interface.

value.zh: 按设备任务确认线材类别、导体结构、目标速率和总长，再确定所需信道验证；不以RJ45外形直接声明速率。
value.en: Confirm cable category, conductor construction, target rate and overall length from the equipment task, then set channel checks. RJ45 form alone does not establish rate.

value.zh: 分别定义线缆屏蔽、连接器壳体和接地安排，核对分支或过渡处的屏蔽路径及端头应力支撑。
value.en: Define cable shielding, connector shells and grounding separately. Review the shield path and strain support at branches and transitions.

value.zh: 设备如使用PoE，确认适用模式、线对使用、负载和温升要求；独立电源支路与网络通道分别记录。
value.en: If the equipment uses PoE, define its mode, pair use, load and thermal requirements. Record separate power branches independently from network channels.

value.zh: 以端口位置确认总长、分支长度与标签，再约定导通、线序、屏蔽和目标网络测试的范围与记录。
value.en: Set overall and branch lengths and labels from port positions, then agree continuity, wiring, shield and target-network test scope and records.

text.zh: 以设备端口及目标传输要求确定铜缆连接方案，审核端头方向、锁扣操作和屏蔽接续。额定速率与通道表现需要对应所选线材、总长及实际端接。
text.en: Define the copper-cable connection from equipment ports and target transmission requirements. Review end direction, latch access and shield continuity; establish rate and channel performance from the selected cable, overall length and actual termination.

text.zh: 配线面板、墙面网络出口与设备间的连接，需要明确端口编号、布线标准和长度。端头结构按面板空间安排，避免把拉力或急弯集中在锁扣后方。
text.en: Connections between patch panels, network outlets and equipment need port IDs, a wiring convention and defined lengths. Arrange ends for the available panel space, keeping pulling loads and sharp bends away from the connector exit.

text.zh: 机架跳接以设备间距和端口排布确定线长及整理路径。多路组件可把端口分组纳入线号；单路组件则兼顾短跳接与可拆模块的维护余量。
text.en: Set rack-jumper lengths and organization from device spacing and port layout. Include port grouping in labels for multiway assemblies; for individual links, balance a short route with the allowance needed to remove equipment modules.

text.zh: 控制器或设备模块采用铜缆网络接口时，先核对网络制式、接线表和屏蔽方案，再安排柜内路径。接口外形相同并不表示不同通信任务可以共用同一接线。
text.en: For controllers or modules using copper network interfaces, confirm the network system, wiring map and shielding before arranging the cabinet route. Matching connector outlines do not establish the same wiring for different communication tasks.

text.zh: 多端口设备可按模块与通道整理分支，逐路标明对应端口和去向。RJ21等集中接口另需完整针位表，不按线色推断RJ45分配或网络速率。
text.en: Organize branches by module and channel at multiport equipment, identifying each port and destination. Concentrated interfaces such as RJ21 need a complete contact map; wire colors do not establish RJ45 allocation or network rate.

text.zh: 设备扩展或检修跳接需保留插拔空间、端口可见性和适当余长。更改线长、接续件或分支后，按目标连接用途重新确认导通、线序与所需信道验证。
text.en: Equipment extensions and service links need mating clearance, visible port IDs and manageable slack. After changing lengths, joints or branches, reconfirm continuity, wiring order and any required channel checks for the intended connection task.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下方向围绕铜缆网络及设备端口展开。实际网络制式、线序、供电与验收以设备资料和选定线材为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover copper network cabling and equipment ports. Define network system, wiring, supply and acceptance from equipment documents and the selected cable.

text.zh: 把设备端口图转为逐针连接表，定义直通、交叉与分支分配，并让标签与端口编号保持对应。
text.en: Convert equipment-port drawings into a contact map defining straight-through, crossover and branch allocation. Keep labels aligned with port IDs.

text.zh: 结合面板和机架空间安排端头朝向、总长与分支长度；屏蔽、护套及固定保护按实际敷设条件选择。
text.en: Arrange end direction, overall length and branch lengths around panels and racks. Select shielding, jackets and retention protection for the actual installation conditions.

text.zh: 样品确认时核对对插、线序和安装尺寸；网络传输与PoE相关检查按指定线材、长度、设备及验收要求单独定义。
text.en: Review mating, wiring order and installed dimensions at sample approval. Define network-transmission and PoE checks for the specified cable, length, equipment and acceptance requirements.

question.zh: RJ45端头是否代表固定网络速率？
question.en: Does an RJ45 end establish a network rate?

answer.zh: 不代表。网络表现取决于线材结构、端接、长度与设备要求。先确定目标连接任务，再定义线材与测试条件。
answer.en: It does not. Network performance depends on cable construction, termination, length and equipment requirements. Define the connection task before selecting the cable and test conditions.

question.zh: 多路RJ45分支能直接按颜色接线吗？
question.en: Can multiway RJ45 branches be wired by color alone?

answer.zh: 需按设备端口与逐针映射确认。分支数量或RJ21外形不能说明每路承载哪种信号，也不能默认全部线对用于以太网。
answer.en: Use equipment-port documents and a contact map. Branch count or an RJ21 outline does not establish each signal assignment, and not every pair can be assumed to carry Ethernet.

question.zh: 带供电的网络项目需要补充什么？
question.en: What is needed for a powered network connection?

answer.zh: 补充供电方式、负载、PoE模式或独立电源电路、线长和热条件。数据路径与电源路径分别定义，并确认整机端接口要求。
answer.en: Provide the supply method, load, PoE mode or separate power circuit, cable length and thermal conditions. Define data and power paths separately and confirm the equipment-side interface requirements.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂围绕设备端口、线序与安装路径提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM支持。确认端头、线材和制造图后组织样品，网络传输与供电相关验收按项目要求确定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support around equipment ports, wiring maps and routing. Approve ends, cables and manufacturing drawings for sample builds, with network-transmission and powered-link acceptance defined for the project.

title.zh: 从设备端口与连接表开始
title.en: Start with equipment ports and the connection map

text.zh: 提供两端接口、逐针或逐端口对应、网络与供电任务、目标长度和安装布局，我们据此梳理端接、样品与验收要求。
text.en: Share end interfaces, contact or port mapping, network and power tasks, target lengths and the installation layout to define termination, samples and acceptance requirements.

text.zh: 导线向不同端头分出，形成独立接入位置。各支路可围绕设备模块分别安排长度与方向。
text.en: Conductors separate toward different ends, creating individual connection points. Branch lengths and directions can follow the equipment modules.

text.zh: 端头采用RJ45形式，可围绕端口朝向、锁扣操作和线缆出口安排设备连接。
text.en: The RJ45-form end supports routing around port direction, latch access and cable exit.

text.zh: 在接口外形之外确认信号类型、线对分配、屏蔽连续性和端接方法；传输能力应按实际线材、长度及整机验证结果确定。
text.en: Define signal type, pair allocation, shield continuity and termination as well as the connector shape. Establish transmission performance from the actual cable, length and system validation.

lede.zh: 双端网络形式连接提供清晰的点对点布线路径，端头方向、锁扣操作与线缆长度可围绕设备位置安排。传输要求以实际线材和完整连接方案确认。
lede.en: Network-form ends at both ends provide a clear point-to-point route. End orientation, latch access and cable length can follow equipment positions, with transmission requirements defined for the actual cable and complete connection plan.

text.zh: 样品确认时核对对插、线序和安装尺寸；网络传输与PoE相关检查按指定线材、长度、设备及验收要求单独定义。
text.en: Review mating, wiring order and installed dimensions at sample approval. Define network-transmission and PoE checks for the specified cable, length, equipment and acceptance requirements.

question.zh: RJ45端头是否代表固定网络速率？
question.en: Does an RJ45 end establish a network rate?

answer.zh: 不代表。网络表现取决于线材结构、端接、长度与设备要求。先确定目标连接任务，再定义线材与测试条件。
answer.en: It does not. Network performance depends on cable construction, termination, length and equipment requirements. Define the connection task before selecting the cable and test conditions.

question.zh: 多路RJ45分支能直接按颜色接线吗？
question.en: Can multiway RJ45 branches be wired by color alone?

answer.zh: 需按设备端口与逐针映射确认。分支数量或RJ21外形不能说明每路承载哪种信号，也不能默认全部线对用于以太网。
answer.en: Use equipment-port documents and a contact map. Branch count or an RJ21 outline does not establish each signal assignment, and not every pair can be assumed to carry Ethernet.

question.zh: 带供电的网络项目需要补充什么？
question.en: What is needed for a powered network connection?

answer.zh: 补充供电方式、负载、PoE模式或独立电源电路、线长和热条件。数据路径与电源路径分别定义，并确认整机端接口要求。
answer.en: Provide the supply method, load, PoE mode or separate power circuit, cable length and thermal conditions. Define data and power paths separately and confirm the equipment-side interface requirements.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂围绕设备端口、线序与安装路径提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM支持。确认端头、线材和制造图后组织样品，网络传输与供电相关验收按项目要求确定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support around equipment ports, wiring maps and routing. Approve ends, cables and manufacturing drawings for sample builds, with network-transmission and powered-link acceptance defined for the project.

title.zh: 从设备端口与连接表开始
title.en: Start with equipment ports and the connection map

text.zh: 提供两端接口、逐针或逐端口对应、网络与供电任务、目标长度和安装布局，我们据此梳理端接、样品与验收要求。
text.en: Share end interfaces, contact or port mapping, network and power tasks, target lengths and the installation layout to define termination, samples and acceptance requirements.

text.zh: 端头采用RJ45形式，可围绕端口朝向、锁扣操作和线缆出口安排设备连接。
text.en: The RJ45-form end supports routing around port direction, latch access and cable exit.

text.zh: 线缆在两端设置连接位置，可结合设备间距和端口朝向安排整体走线。
text.en: Connection points sit at both cable ends, with the route arranged for equipment spacing and port orientation.

text.zh: 在接口外形之外确认信号类型、线对分配、屏蔽连续性和端接方法；传输能力应按实际线材、长度及整机验证结果确定。
text.en: Define signal type, pair allocation, shield continuity and termination as well as the connector shape. Establish transmission performance from the actual cable, length and system validation.

lede.zh: 双端网络形式连接提供清晰的点对点布线路径，端头方向、锁扣操作与线缆长度可围绕设备位置安排。传输要求以实际线材和完整连接方案确认。
lede.en: Network-form ends at both ends provide a clear point-to-point route. End orientation, latch access and cable length can follow equipment positions, with transmission requirements defined for the actual cable and complete connection plan.

quickPoints.zh: 传输与供电按项目确认

structureIntro.zh: 先看端头形式与支路安排，再用设备端口表明确各路连接用途。铜缆的线对、屏蔽与供电要求分开定义。
structureIntro.en: Review end forms and branch arrangement, then use equipment-port records to define each connection task. Specify copper pairs, shielding and supply requirements separately.

value.zh: 记录RJ45或RJ21等端头的完整形式、端口资料、锁扣与安装方向；屏蔽壳体和普通壳体分别确认。
value.en: Record the complete RJ45, RJ21 or other end form, port documents, latch and installation direction. Confirm shielded and unshielded housing configurations separately.

value.zh: 确定逐针对应、线对分配、直通或交叉关系。多路组件需要每个端口与主接口的完整对应表。
value.en: Define contact mapping, pair allocation and straight-through or crossover connections. Multiway assemblies need a complete map between every branch port and the main interface.

value.zh: 按设备任务确认线材类别、导体结构、目标速率和总长，再确定所需信道验证；不以RJ45外形直接声明速率。
value.en: Confirm cable category, conductor construction, target rate and overall length from the equipment task, then set channel checks. RJ45 form alone does not establish rate.

value.zh: 分别定义线缆屏蔽、连接器壳体和接地安排，核对分支或过渡处的屏蔽路径及端头应力支撑。
value.en: Define cable shielding, connector shells and grounding separately. Review the shield path and strain support at branches and transitions.

value.zh: 设备如使用PoE，确认适用模式、线对使用、负载和温升要求；独立电源支路与网络通道分别记录。
value.en: If the equipment uses PoE, define its mode, pair use, load and thermal requirements. Record separate power branches independently from network channels.

value.zh: 以端口位置确认总长、分支长度与标签，再约定导通、线序、屏蔽和目标网络测试的范围与记录。
value.en: Set overall and branch lengths and labels from port positions, then agree continuity, wiring, shield and target-network test scope and records.

text.zh: 以设备端口及目标传输要求确定铜缆连接方案，审核端头方向、锁扣操作和屏蔽接续。额定速率与通道表现需要对应所选线材、总长及实际端接。
text.en: Define the copper-cable connection from equipment ports and target transmission requirements. Review end direction, latch access and shield continuity; establish rate and channel performance from the selected cable, overall length and actual termination.

text.zh: 配线面板、墙面网络出口与设备间的连接，需要明确端口编号、布线标准和长度。端头结构按面板空间安排，避免把拉力或急弯集中在锁扣后方。
text.en: Connections between patch panels, network outlets and equipment need port IDs, a wiring convention and defined lengths. Arrange ends for the available panel space, keeping pulling loads and sharp bends away from the connector exit.

text.zh: 机架跳接以设备间距和端口排布确定线长及整理路径。多路组件可把端口分组纳入线号；单路组件则兼顾短跳接与可拆模块的维护余量。
text.en: Set rack-jumper lengths and organization from device spacing and port layout. Include port grouping in labels for multiway assemblies; for individual links, balance a short route with the allowance needed to remove equipment modules.

text.zh: 控制器或设备模块采用铜缆网络接口时，先核对网络制式、接线表和屏蔽方案，再安排柜内路径。接口外形相同并不表示不同通信任务可以共用同一接线。
text.en: For controllers or modules using copper network interfaces, confirm the network system, wiring map and shielding before arranging the cabinet route. Matching connector outlines do not establish the same wiring for different communication tasks.

text.zh: 多端口设备可按模块与通道整理分支，逐路标明对应端口和去向。RJ21等集中接口另需完整针位表，不按线色推断RJ45分配或网络速率。
text.en: Organize branches by module and channel at multiport equipment, identifying each port and destination. Concentrated interfaces such as RJ21 need a complete contact map; wire colors do not establish RJ45 allocation or network rate.

text.zh: 设备扩展或检修跳接需保留插拔空间、端口可见性和适当余长。更改线长、接续件或分支后，按目标连接用途重新确认导通、线序与所需信道验证。
text.en: Equipment extensions and service links need mating clearance, visible port IDs and manageable slack. After changing lengths, joints or branches, reconfirm continuity, wiring order and any required channel checks for the intended connection task.

applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover copper network cabling and equipment ports. Define network system, wiring, supply and acceptance from equipment documents and the selected cable.

text.zh: 把设备端口图转为逐针连接表，定义直通、交叉与分支分配，并让标签与端口编号保持对应。
text.en: Convert equipment-port drawings into a contact map defining straight-through, crossover and branch allocation. Keep labels aligned with port IDs.

text.en: Arrange end direction, overall length and branch lengths around panels and racks. Select shielding, jackets and retention protection for the actual installation conditions.
