lede.zh: 网络形式端头与独立支路线段组合，可用于讨论门控设备项目中的数据接入和供电布置。PoE任务、独立供电及各支路功能按设备电路分别确认。
lede.en: Network-form ends are combined with separate branch sections for discussion of data entry and supply routing in door-control equipment projects. Define PoE, any independent supply and each branch function from the equipment circuit documents.

quickPoints.zh: 传输与供电按项目确认

structureIntro.zh: 先看端头形式与支路安排，再用设备端口表明确各路连接用途。铜缆的线对、屏蔽与供电要求分开定义。
structureIntro.en: Review end forms and branch arrangement, then use equipment-port records to define each connection task. Specify copper pairs, shielding and supply requirements separately.

value.zh: 记录RJ45或RJ21等端头的完整形式、端口资料、锁扣与安装方向；屏蔽壳体和普通壳体分别确认。
value.en: Record the complete RJ45, RJ21 or other end form, port documents, latch and installation direction. Confirm shielded and unshielded housing configurations separately.

value.zh: 确定逐针对应、线对分配、直通或交叉关系。多路组件需要每个端口与主接口的完整对应表。
value.en: Define contact mapping, pair allocation and straight-through or crossover connections. Multiway assemblies need a complete map between every branch port and the main interface.

value.zh: 按设备任务确认线材类别、导体结构、目标速率和总长，再确定所需信道验证；不以RJ45外形直接声明速率。
value.en: Confirm cable category, conductor construction, target rate and overall length from the equipment task, then set channel checks. RJ45 form alone does not establish rate.

value.zh: 分别定义线缆屏蔽、连接器壳体和接地安排，核对分支或过渡处的屏蔽路径及端头应力支撑。
value.en: Define cable shielding, connector shells and grounding separately. Review the shield path and strain support at branches and transitions.

value.zh: 确认设备的PoE模式或独立电源方式、各支路负载及接地，不能把所有分支默认视为同一供电接口。
value.en: Define the equipment PoE mode or separate supply, individual branch loads and grounding. Do not assume every branch uses the same supply interface.

value.zh: 以端口位置确认总长、分支长度与标签，再约定导通、线序、屏蔽和目标网络测试的范围与记录。
value.en: Set overall and branch lengths and labels from port positions, then agree continuity, wiring, shield and target-network test scope and records.

text.zh: 以设备端口及目标传输要求确定铜缆连接方案，审核端头方向、锁扣操作和屏蔽接续。额定速率与通道表现需要对应所选线材、总长及实际端接。
text.en: Define the copper-cable connection from equipment ports and target transmission requirements. Review end direction, latch access and shield continuity; establish rate and channel performance from the selected cable, overall length and actual termination.

text.zh: 配线面板、墙面网络出口与设备间的连接，需要明确端口编号、布线标准和长度。端头结构按面板空间安排，避免把拉力或急弯集中在锁扣后方。
text.en: Connections between patch panels, network outlets and equipment need port IDs, a wiring convention and defined lengths. Arrange ends for the available panel space, keeping pulling loads and sharp bends away from the connector exit.

text.zh: 机架跳接以设备间距和端口排布确定线长及整理路径。多路组件可把端口分组纳入线号；单路组件则兼顾短跳接与可拆模块的维护余量。
text.en: Set rack-jumper lengths and organization from device spacing and port layout. Include port grouping in labels for multiway assemblies; for individual links, balance a short route with the allowance needed to remove equipment modules.

text.zh: 控制器或设备模块采用铜缆网络接口时，先核对网络制式、接线表和屏蔽方案，再安排柜内路径。接口外形相同并不表示不同通信任务可以共用同一接线。
text.en: For controllers or modules using copper network interfaces, confirm the network system, wiring map and shielding before arranging the cabinet route. Matching connector outlines do not establish the same wiring for different communication tasks.

text.zh: 门控联网模块需要区分网络数据、设备供电和其他控制支路。按控制器与模块的端口资料安排分支及标签，再确定PoE或独立电源的实际连接方式。
text.en: Networked door-control modules need separate definitions for network data, equipment supply and other control branches. Use controller and module port documents to arrange branches and labels, then define PoE or the actual independent supply connection.

text.zh: 设备扩展或检修跳接需保留插拔空间、端口可见性和适当余长。更改线长、接续件或分支后，按目标连接用途重新确认导通、线序与所需信道验证。
text.en: Equipment extensions and service links need mating clearance, visible port IDs and manageable slack. After changing lengths, joints or branches, reconfirm continuity, wiring order and any required channel checks for the intended connection task.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下方向围绕铜缆网络及设备端口展开。实际网络制式、线序、供电与验收以设备资料和选定线材为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover copper network cabling and equipment ports. Define network system, wiring, supply and acceptance from equipment documents and the selected cable.

text.zh: 把设备端口图转为逐针连接表，定义直通、交叉与分支分配，并让标签与端口编号保持对应。
text.en: Convert equipment-port drawings into a contact map defining straight-through, crossover and branch allocation. Keep labels aligned with port IDs.

text.zh: 结合面板和机架空间安排端头朝向、总长与分支长度；屏蔽、护套及固定保护按实际敷设条件选择。
text.en: Arrange end direction, overall length and branch lengths around panels and racks. Select shielding, jackets and retention protection for the actual installation conditions.

text.zh: 样品确认时核对对插、线序和安装尺寸；网络传输与PoE相关检查按指定线材、长度、设备及验收要求单独定义。
text.en: Review mating, wiring order and installed dimensions at sample approval. Define network-transmission and PoE checks for the specified cable, length, equipment and acceptance requirements.

question.zh: RJ45端头是否代表固定网络速率？
question.en: Does an RJ45 end establish a network rate?

answer.zh: 不代表。网络表现取决于线材结构、端接、长度与设备要求。先确定目标连接任务，再定义线材与测试条件。
answer.en: It does not. Network performance depends on cable construction, termination, length and equipment requirements. Define the connection task before selecting the cable and test conditions.

question.zh: 多路RJ45分支能直接按颜色接线吗？
question.en: Can multiway RJ45 branches be wired by color alone?

answer.zh: 需按设备端口与逐针映射确认。分支数量或RJ21外形不能说明每路承载哪种信号，也不能默认全部线对用于以太网。
answer.en: Use equipment-port documents and a contact map. Branch count or an RJ21 outline does not establish each signal assignment, and not every pair can be assumed to carry Ethernet.

question.zh: 带供电的网络项目需要补充什么？
question.en: What is needed for a powered network connection?

answer.zh: 补充供电方式、负载、PoE模式或独立电源电路、线长和热条件。数据路径与电源路径分别定义，并确认整机端接口要求。
answer.en: Provide the supply method, load, PoE mode or separate power circuit, cable length and thermal conditions. Define data and power paths separately and confirm the equipment-side interface requirements.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂围绕设备端口、线序与安装路径提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM支持。确认端头、线材和制造图后组织样品，网络传输与供电相关验收按项目要求确定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support around equipment ports, wiring maps and routing. Approve ends, cables and manufacturing drawings for sample builds, with network-transmission and powered-link acceptance defined for the project.

title.zh: 从设备端口与连接表开始
title.en: Start with equipment ports and the connection map

text.zh: 提供两端接口、逐针或逐端口对应、网络与供电任务、目标长度和安装布局，我们据此梳理端接、样品与验收要求。
text.en: Share end interfaces, contact or port mapping, network and power tasks, target lengths and the installation layout to define termination, samples and acceptance requirements.

text.zh: 导线向不同端头分出，形成独立接入位置。各支路可围绕设备模块分别安排长度与方向。
text.en: Conductors separate toward different ends, creating individual connection points. Branch lengths and directions can follow the equipment modules.

text.zh: 端头采用插接形式，可围绕安装位置安排插入、退出及线缆弯曲空间。
text.en: The end uses a plug-in form, with clearance arranged for insertion, removal and cable bends.

text.zh: 按设备端视图明确各端头用途，网络端口与独立供电或控制支路分别记录，再将线号与实际端口对应。
text.en: Define each end function from equipment end views. Record network ports and separate power or control branches independently, then align cable IDs with the actual ports.

lede.zh: 多路网络形式端头与集中线段组合，可围绕设备端口分组安排支路长度、线号与安装顺序。线序和实际承载任务需按设备连接表定义。
lede.en: Multiple network-form ends are combined with a gathered cable section. Branch lengths, labels and installation order can follow equipment port groups, with wiring and the actual task defined by the equipment connection map.

text.en: For controllers or modules using copper network interfaces, confirm the network system, wiring map and shielding before arranging the cabinet route. Matching connector outlines do not establish the same wiring for different communication tasks.

text.zh: 多端口设备可按模块与通道整理分支，逐路标明对应端口和去向。RJ21等集中接口另需完整针位表，不按线色推断RJ45分配或网络速率。
text.en: Organize branches by module and channel at multiport equipment, identifying each port and destination. Concentrated interfaces such as RJ21 need a complete contact map; wire colors do not establish RJ45 allocation or network rate.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂围绕设备端口、线序与安装路径提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM支持。确认端头、线材和制造图后组织样品，网络传输与供电相关验收按项目要求确定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support around equipment ports, wiring maps and routing. Approve ends, cables and manufacturing drawings for sample builds, with network-transmission and powered-link acceptance defined for the project.

text.zh: 提供两端接口、逐针或逐端口对应、网络与供电任务、目标长度和安装布局，我们据此梳理端接、样品与验收要求。

text.en: Record ends, pairs and branch destinations from equipment end views, using the same map for port IDs and cable labels.

lede.zh: M12八针圆形接头尾线束的结构重点包括M12圆形接口形式、插接式端头、尾线连接形式。接口、电路与安装资料将作为尺寸、物料和样品制作的确认依据。
lede.en: M12 8-Pin Circular Connector Pigtail combines m12 circular interface form, plug-in connection end, pigtail connection form. Interface, circuit and installation data guide dimensions, material selection and sample review.

structureIntro.zh: 以M12八针圆形接头尾线束的结构形式为起点，结合图纸和实际设备确认以下设计要点。
structureIntro.en: Use the m12 8-pin circular connector pigtail form as a starting point and confirm these design points against drawings and the actual equipment.

text.zh: M12形式的圆形接入端可结合设备对插位置安排方向、操作空间与出线位置。
text.en: The M12-form circular end can be oriented around the equipment mating position, handling clearance and cable exit.

text.zh: 插接端后保留引线段，便于按设备接线位置确定长度、后续端接与支撑。
text.en: A lead section extends behind the connector, allowing length, further termination and support to follow the equipment connection.

text.zh: 接口另一端保留多根分色引线，后续端接与线色对应可按设备接线资料定义。
text.en: The opposite end retains several color-coded leads. Define further termination and color mapping from the equipment wiring data.

label.zh: 圆形接口系列、编码与对插件
label.en: Circular interface family, coding and mating part

value.zh: 记录完整型号、编码、公母与插合面，不能只按M12名称或针数替换。
value.en: Record full references, coding, gender and mating-face views. The M12 name or contact count alone is insufficient for replacement.

label.en: Pin numbers, colors and circuit mapping

value.zh: 按插合面视图定义针号，将线色与设备端功能逐一对应。
value.en: Define pin numbering from the mating-face view and map conductor colors to equipment-side functions.

label.zh: 端头方向、线长与固定基准
label.en: End orientation, length and fixing datums

value.zh: 按设备位置定义直头或弯头、展开长度及固定点；卷线还需定义收拢与使用长度。
value.en: Define straight or angled ends, extended length and fixing points for the equipment. Coiled leads also need retracted and working lengths.

value.zh: 线径、绝缘、护套和所需屏蔽按回路与环境选配，金属外壳不单独证明屏蔽性能。
value.en: Select conductor size, insulation, jacket and any shield for the circuits and environment. A metal shell alone does not establish shielding.

value.zh: 提供对插端资料、针脚表、回路电压电流、线长、环境与安装方式。额定和防护按完整配置确认。
value.en: Provide mating-part data, a pin map, circuit voltage and current, length, environment and installation method. Ratings and protection require the complete configuration.

value.zh: 首件确认端接、插合锁紧、尺寸与回路对应，再按批准图纸和检验要求组织制造。
value.en: Confirm termination, mating and coupling, dimensions and circuit mapping on the first article. Manufacture against approved drawings and inspection requirements.

text.zh: 依据传感器的接口系列、键位和针脚定义安排设备接入点，线长从固定位置量取。
text.en: Plan equipment connections from the sensor interface family, keying and pin definition. Measure cable length from the fixing positions.

text.zh: 将圆形接口的针号与柜内端点逐一对应，保留插拔、锁紧和检修操作空间。
text.en: Map circular-interface pins to cabinet endpoints and preserve access for mating, coupling and service.

text.zh: 按仪器资料区分电源、信号与参考回路；接口形状不能代替实际信号定义。
text.en: Separate power, signal and reference circuits using the instrument documentation. Interface shape does not define the signal function.

text.zh: 围绕传感器、辅助模块与设备固定点安排连接线，并确认油污、温度与运动条件。
text.en: Route leads around sensors, auxiliary modules and equipment fixing points. Confirm oil exposure, temperature and any movement.

title.zh: 分析设备与自动化模块

text.zh: 结合模块位置和拆装路径定义端头朝向、出线与线长，保持与设备接口资料一致。
text.en: Define end orientation, cable exits and length around module positions and removal paths, using the equipment interface data.

text.zh: 更换或延长连接前核对完整对插型号、接点排列和锁紧结构，按安装位置预留弯曲空间。
text.en: Check complete mating references, contact arrangement and coupling before replacement or extension. Allow cable bends for the installation position.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕圆形设备接口展开，实际适配、回路与性能依据具体设备资料确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These connection directions concern circular equipment interfaces. Confirm fit, circuits and performance from the actual equipment data.

title.zh: 圆形接口系列、编码与对插件
title.en: Circular interface family, coding and mating part

text.zh: 记录完整型号、编码、公母与插合面，不能只按M12名称或针数替换。
text.en: Record full references, coding, gender and mating-face views. The M12 name or contact count alone is insufficient for replacement.

title.zh: 端头方向、线长与固定基准
title.en: End orientation, length and fixing datums

text.zh: 按设备位置定义直头或弯头、展开长度及固定点；卷线还需定义收拢与使用长度。
text.en: Define straight or angled ends, extended length and fixing points for the equipment. Coiled leads also need retracted and working lengths.

text.zh: 首件确认端接、插合锁紧、尺寸与回路对应，再按批准图纸和检验要求组织制造。
text.en: Confirm termination, mating and coupling, dimensions and circuit mapping on the first article. Manufacture against approved drawings and inspection requirements.

question.zh: 针数相同的M12线可以直接替换吗？
question.en: Can M12 leads with equal contact counts be substituted directly?

answer.zh: 不能。还需核对编码、键位、公母、针号、锁紧结构和设备回路定义。
answer.en: No. Check coding, keying, gender, pin numbering, coupling and the equipment circuit definition.

question.zh: 金属壳体或螺纹外形能证明屏蔽与防水吗？
question.en: Does a metal shell or threaded shape establish shielding and waterproofing?

answer.zh: 不能。屏蔽端接、壳体连续、密封件、线缆外径及完整插合状态都需要按具体配置确认。
answer.en: No. Confirm shield termination, shell continuity, seals, cable diameter and the complete mated state for the exact configuration.

question.zh: 卷线或延长线能直接沿用原线的性能吗？
question.en: Can a coiled or extended lead inherit the original cable performance?

answer.zh: 不能直接沿用。需重新核对使用长度、弯曲与固定、压降或信号路径，以及要求的机械和环境验证。
answer.en: Not automatically. Review working length, bends and fixing, voltage drop or signal path, and the required mechanical and environmental validation.

value.zh: 记录双方针脚与线对对应、设备信号要求和目标通信速率。
value.en: Record pin and pair mapping on both sides, equipment signal requirements and the target communication rate.

value.zh: 按目标链路选配线对结构、阻抗、屏蔽及长度，完整组件能力需结合两端设备确认。
value.en: Select pairs, impedance, shielding and length for the target link. Confirm complete-assembly capability with both devices.

label.en: Retention, cable exits and installation space

value.zh: 核对锁扣或螺纹锁紧、护套外径、出线方向及后方弯曲和维护空间。
value.en: Check latch or threaded retention, jacket diameter, exit direction and rear bend and service clearance.

value.zh: 提供设备端口、网络用途、针脚表、线长和敷设环境。若要求PoE或其他供电，需单独定义回路与验证要求。
value.en: Provide device ports, network function, a pin map, length and installation environment. Define circuits and validation separately if PoE or another power function is required.

value.zh: 首件核对端接、线对、屏蔽路径及尺寸；导通以外的通信性能按设备与项目约定验证。
value.en: Check termination, pairs, shield path and dimensions on the first article. Validate communication performance beyond continuity against the equipment and project requirements.

text.zh: 依据控制器端口、网络架构和完整接口资料选择线缆结构；协议与速率另行确认。
text.en: Select cable construction from controller ports, network architecture and complete interface data. Confirm protocol and rate separately.

text.zh: 结合面板后方空间安排数据接口、长度和应力支撑，保留端口插拔与锁扣操作位置。
text.en: Arrange data interfaces, length and strain support around rear-panel space. Keep ports and latches accessible.

text.zh: 按设备端口组织跳接与走线，明确链路两端、线对关系和屏蔽接地要求。
text.en: Organize patching and routing around equipment ports. Define both link endpoints, pair mapping and shield grounding.

text.zh: 按外围模块端口安排通信连接，固定与运动段分别审核；循环寿命需要具体线缆与试验依据。
text.en: Plan communication connections from peripheral-module ports. Review fixed and moving sections separately; cycle life needs exact cable and test evidence.

text.zh: 在控制器与设备模块之间规划数据路径，核对接口、布线长度及设备规定的通信验证方法。
text.en: Plan data paths between controllers and equipment modules. Check interfaces, route length and the equipment-defined communication validation.

text.zh: 维护换线时核对两端接口和针脚定义，按端口位置安排跳接长度与标签，验证完整链路。
text.en: Check both interfaces and pin definitions when replacing leads. Set patch length and labels for the port locations and validate the complete link.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下连接方向围绕设备数据接口展开，实际适配、回路与性能依据具体设备资料确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These connection directions concern equipment data interfaces. Confirm fit, circuits and performance from the actual equipment data.

title.en: Both interfaces and complete part numbers

text.zh: 明确RJ45、IX或M12等两端接口的完整系列、方向与对插件，不以品牌名称替代接口定义。
text.en: Define the full family, orientation and mating parts for both ends, such as RJ45, IX or M12. A brand name does not define the interface.

text.zh: 按目标链路选配线对结构、阻抗、屏蔽及长度，完整组件能力需结合两端设备确认。
text.en: Select pairs, impedance, shielding and length for the target link. Confirm complete-assembly capability with both devices.

text.zh: 首件核对端接、线对、屏蔽路径及尺寸；导通以外的通信性能按设备与项目约定验证。
text.en: Check termination, pairs, shield path and dimensions on the first article. Validate communication performance beyond continuity against the equipment and project requirements.

question.zh: 接口外形相同就能保证数据兼容吗？
question.en: Does a matching interface shape guarantee data compatibility?

answer.zh: 不能。还需确认完整系列、针脚与线对、设备通信方式、线缆结构和实际链路要求。
answer.en: No. Confirm the full family, pin and pair mapping, equipment communication, cable construction and actual link requirements.

question.zh: 导通合格是否代表网络通信性能合格？
question.en: Does continuity acceptance establish network performance?

answer.zh: 不能。通信还受线对结构、端接、阻抗、屏蔽、长度和两端设备影响，需要相应链路验证。
answer.en: No. Pairs, termination, impedance, shielding, length and both devices affect communication and need appropriate link validation.

question.zh: 有RJ45或M12接口就可以承载PoE吗？
question.en: Does an RJ45 or M12 interface establish PoE capability?

answer.zh: 不能。供电功能、针脚分配、导体与接点能力、温升及整机兼容需另行确认。
answer.en: No. Confirm the power function, pin allocation, conductor and contact limits, temperature rise and equipment compatibility separately.

title.en: Vehicle Cigarette-Lighter Plug to Dual Battery Clamps Harness

category.zh: 电池辅助电源与维护连接线
category.en: Battery auxiliary power and maintenance leads

lede.zh: 图示组件将车载点烟器式插头与红黑夹钳组合，可按辅助电源连接需求评审线长、极性和夹持方式。本页用途范围为辅助供电与电池维护连接，启动机大电流需另行设计验证。
lede.en: The pictured assembly combines a vehicle cigarette-lighter-style plug with red and black clamps. Lead length, polarity and clamp arrangements can be reviewed for an auxiliary-power connection. This page covers auxiliary supply and battery maintenance; starter-motor current requires a separate design and validation.

title.zh: 点烟器插头与红黑夹钳

text.zh: 以上结构可在实拍中识别。各端接入设备、供电方向和允许负载应由回路资料确定。
text.en: These connection forms are visible in the photograph. Define the equipment at each end, supply direction and permitted electrical duty from circuit documentation.

text.zh: 红黑夹钳用于区分连接端。生产文件还需明确正负极、接触位置、夹持范围及端头绝缘，不能只凭颜色判定整机接法。
text.en: Red and black clamps distinguish the connection ends. Manufacturing documents must define polarity, contact locations, grip range and end insulation; color alone does not establish the system connection.

text.zh: 按实际接点距离确定引线长度，预留插拔和夹钳操作空间；可盘绕收纳不等于具备反复拉伸或弹簧回缩性能。
text.en: Set lead length from the actual connection distance and allow room for mating and clamp handling. A lead looped for storage does not establish repeated-extension or spring-retraction performance.

text.zh: 本示例按辅助供电与电池维护连接讨论，启动机大电流不在已确认用途范围。负载、压降、器件额定和保护配置需要项目确认。
text.en: This example is scoped to auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside the confirmed application scope. Confirm the load, voltage drop, component ratings and circuit protection for the project.

value.zh: 提供两端设备的输入或输出资料，确认电压、供电方向及允许使用方式。
value.en: Provide input/output data for the equipment at both ends; confirm voltage, supply direction and permitted use.

value.zh: 按附件或维护设备资料确定工作电流、使用时长及保护要求，不采用发动机起动电流作为本页选型依据。
value.en: Define current, operating duration and protection from accessory or maintenance-equipment data. Engine-starting current is outside this page’s selection scope.

label.zh: 点烟器式插头与对插尺寸

value.zh: 以对插件资料核对尺寸、插合保持方式和正负极位置，外形接近仍需对插验证。
value.en: Check dimensions, mating retention and polarity against the mating component; verify the connection even when outlines appear similar.

value.zh: 确认目标接点、夹口范围、接触方式、正负标识及绝缘覆盖。
value.en: Confirm contact points, jaw range, contact arrangement, polarity marking and insulation coverage.

value.zh: 导体截面、总长度、压降及保险器件按实际辅助负载共同评审；具体额定以确认物料为准。
value.en: Review conductor size, total length, voltage drop and protection for the auxiliary load. Ratings depend on the approved components.

value.zh: 确认端头型号、回路图、极性、长度、物料表和检验点，再进行样品试装与重复制造。
value.en: Approve end-component references, circuit drawing, polarity, length, BOM and inspection points for sample fitting and repeat manufacture.

text.zh: 围绕电池维护设备的接入位置，确认正负极、夹钳操作空间和充电器接口。充电方式及允许电流由设备资料确定，线束本身不承担充电控制功能。
text.en: Plan access for battery-maintenance equipment around terminal polarity, clamp clearance and the charger interface. Charging method and permitted current come from the equipment documentation; the lead itself does not provide charging control.

text.zh: 用于讨论车内附件的辅助供电接口时，核对插头或插座形式、插合保持力和线长。先确认附件输入及车辆电源口要求，再选择导体与保护配置。
text.en: For a vehicle accessory interface, confirm the plug or socket form, mating retention and lead length. Establish the accessory input and vehicle outlet requirements before selecting conductors, circuit protection and the connection arrangement.

text.zh: 台架样品检查可围绕导通、极性、端头接触和项目要求的压降展开。测试电源须具备适合样品的控制条件，允许电气负载应先由图纸和器件资料确认。
text.en: Bench checks can cover continuity, polarity, terminal contact and the voltage-drop limits agreed for the project. Use a suitably controlled supply and confirm the permitted electrical duty from drawings and component data before testing.

text.zh: 车辆维护中的小型工具或附件接入，需要确认设备输入、接点、作业时长及安全放置位置。此方向用于辅助电源连接评审，不包含起动机跨接启动用途。
text.en: For small tools or accessories used during vehicle service, define the equipment input, connection points, operating duration and a secure lead position. This direction covers auxiliary supply review; starter-motor jump starting is outside its scope.

text.zh: 辅助回路的保险器件、导体、端头和负载应配套评审，保留检修及更换空间。是否配置保险座、器件型号和串联位置，需按具体结构与确认图纸确定。
text.en: Review protection devices, conductors, terminations and the accessory load together, allowing access for service and replacement. Confirm whether a fuse holder is included, its component reference and its circuit position from the actual construction and approved drawing.

text.zh: 车内或维修工位的辅助引线需避开锐边、活动件和受压位置，预留插拔空间。固定点、弯曲余量与实际长度应在样品试装时核对，不凭产品外观确定安装位置。
text.en: Route auxiliary leads clear of sharp edges, moving parts and pinch points in the vehicle or service area. Confirm fixing points, bend allowance, mating clearance and installed length during sample fitting rather than inferring the installation from appearance.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下方向用于辅助供电与电池维护项目讨论。具体接法、允许负载及保护要求以设备资料与样品确认为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions concern auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance projects. Establish the connections, permitted duty and protection from equipment documentation and sample review.

text.zh: 可围绕点烟器式或双极接口、夹钳接点和设备供电方向定义连接表，先确认两端资料。
text.en: Define the connection table around the outlet or two-pole interface, clamp contacts and equipment supply direction. Confirm data for both ends first.

text.zh: 按实际安装或操作距离安排导线、夹钳绝缘和保险座位置；需增加保护器件时同时审核器件与负载。
text.en: Arrange lead length, clamp insulation and fuse-holder location around installation or handling distances. Review any added protection device with the load.

text.zh: 样品阶段核对插合、夹持、极性、导通和约定的电气检查，将确认结果写入图纸与检验文件。
text.en: Check mating, clamp handling, polarity, continuity and agreed electrical criteria at the sample stage; record approved results in drawings and inspection documents.

question.zh: 可以用于发动机跨接起动吗？
question.en: Is this a starter-motor jump lead?

answer.zh: 本页的用途范围为辅助供电与电池维护连接，启动机大电流不在已确认范围。需要跨接起动线时，应独立提供系统和电流工况，另行设计、选料与验证。
answer.en: This page covers auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside its confirmed scope. A jump-starting lead requires a separate system and electrical-duty review, followed by appropriate design, component selection and validation.

question.zh: 带有夹钳或保险座就能确定电流吗？
question.en: Do clamps or a fuse holder establish a current rating?

answer.zh: 载流要求须结合导体、接点、插头或插座、保护器件、长度和使用条件确认。照片中的夹钳大小或保险座外形不能提供整套组件的额定值。
answer.en: Establish electrical duty from the conductors, contacts, plug or socket, protection devices, length and operating conditions. Clamp size or fuse-holder appearance in a photograph does not provide an assembly rating.

question.zh: 连接线是否具有充电或升降压功能？
question.en: Does the lead provide charging or voltage conversion?

answer.zh: 本示例展示连接结构，不声明具备充电控制或升降压功能。连接维护充电器或辅助附件前，需要核对设备功能、供电方向、极性和输入输出要求。
answer.en: The example shows a connection assembly without a claim of charging control or voltage conversion. Before connecting maintenance equipment or an accessory, confirm equipment function, supply direction, polarity and input/output requirements.

text.zh: 红黑夹钳用于区分连接端。生产文件还需明确正负极、接触位置、夹持范围及端头绝缘，不能只凭颜色判定整机接法。
text.en: Red and black clamps distinguish the connection ends. Manufacturing documents must define polarity, contact locations, grip range and end insulation; color alone does not establish the system connection.

text.zh: 按实际接点距离确定引线长度，预留插拔和夹钳操作空间；可盘绕收纳不等于具备反复拉伸或弹簧回缩性能。
text.en: Set lead length from the actual connection distance and allow room for mating and clamp handling. A lead looped for storage does not establish repeated-extension or spring-retraction performance.

text.zh: 本示例按辅助供电与电池维护连接讨论，启动机大电流不在已确认用途范围。负载、压降、器件额定和保护配置需要项目确认。
text.en: This example is scoped to auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside the confirmed application scope. Confirm the load, voltage drop, component ratings and circuit protection for the project.

value.zh: 提供两端设备的输入或输出资料，确认电压、供电方向及允许使用方式。
value.en: Provide input/output data for the equipment at both ends; confirm voltage, supply direction and permitted use.

value.zh: 按附件或维护设备资料确定工作电流、使用时长及保护要求，不采用发动机起动电流作为本页选型依据。
value.en: Define current, operating duration and protection from accessory or maintenance-equipment data. Engine-starting current is outside this page’s selection scope.

label.zh: 点烟器式插头与对插尺寸

value.zh: 以对插件资料核对尺寸、插合保持方式和正负极位置，外形接近仍需对插验证。
value.en: Check dimensions, mating retention and polarity against the mating component; verify the connection even when outlines appear similar.

value.zh: 确认目标接点、夹口范围、接触方式、正负标识及绝缘覆盖。
value.en: Confirm contact points, jaw range, contact arrangement, polarity marking and insulation coverage.

value.zh: 导体截面、总长度、压降及保险器件按实际辅助负载共同评审；具体额定以确认物料为准。
value.en: Review conductor size, total length, voltage drop and protection for the auxiliary load. Ratings depend on the approved components.

value.zh: 确认端头型号、回路图、极性、长度、物料表和检验点，再进行样品试装与重复制造。
value.en: Approve end-component references, circuit drawing, polarity, length, BOM and inspection points for sample fitting and repeat manufacture.

text.zh: 围绕电池维护设备的接入位置，确认正负极、夹钳操作空间和充电器接口。充电方式及允许电流由设备资料确定，线束本身不承担充电控制功能。
text.en: Plan access for battery-maintenance equipment around terminal polarity, clamp clearance and the charger interface. Charging method and permitted current come from the equipment documentation; the lead itself does not provide charging control.

text.zh: 用于讨论车内附件的辅助供电接口时，核对插头或插座形式、插合保持力和线长。先确认附件输入及车辆电源口要求，再选择导体与保护配置。
text.en: For a vehicle accessory interface, confirm the plug or socket form, mating retention and lead length. Establish the accessory input and vehicle outlet requirements before selecting conductors, circuit protection and the connection arrangement.

text.zh: 台架样品检查可围绕导通、极性、端头接触和项目要求的压降展开。测试电源须具备适合样品的控制条件，允许电气负载应先由图纸和器件资料确认。
text.en: Bench checks can cover continuity, polarity, terminal contact and the voltage-drop limits agreed for the project. Use a suitably controlled supply and confirm the permitted electrical duty from drawings and component data before testing.

text.zh: 车辆维护中的小型工具或附件接入，需要确认设备输入、接点、作业时长及安全放置位置。此方向用于辅助电源连接评审，不包含起动机跨接启动用途。
text.en: For small tools or accessories used during vehicle service, define the equipment input, connection points, operating duration and a secure lead position. This direction covers auxiliary supply review; starter-motor jump starting is outside its scope.

text.zh: 辅助回路的保险器件、导体、端头和负载应配套评审，保留检修及更换空间。是否配置保险座、器件型号和串联位置，需按具体结构与确认图纸确定。
text.en: Review protection devices, conductors, terminations and the accessory load together, allowing access for service and replacement. Confirm whether a fuse holder is included, its component reference and its circuit position from the actual construction and approved drawing.

text.zh: 车内或维修工位的辅助引线需避开锐边、活动件和受压位置，预留插拔空间。固定点、弯曲余量与实际长度应在样品试装时核对，不凭产品外观确定安装位置。
text.en: Route auxiliary leads clear of sharp edges, moving parts and pinch points in the vehicle or service area. Confirm fixing points, bend allowance, mating clearance and installed length during sample fitting rather than inferring the installation from appearance.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下方向用于辅助供电与电池维护项目讨论。具体接法、允许负载及保护要求以设备资料与样品确认为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: The following directions concern auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance projects. Establish the connections, permitted duty and protection from equipment documentation and sample review.

text.zh: 可围绕点烟器式或双极接口、夹钳接点和设备供电方向定义连接表，先确认两端资料。
text.en: Define the connection table around the outlet or two-pole interface, clamp contacts and equipment supply direction. Confirm data for both ends first.

text.zh: 按实际安装或操作距离安排导线、夹钳绝缘和保险座位置；需增加保护器件时同时审核器件与负载。
text.en: Arrange lead length, clamp insulation and fuse-holder location around installation or handling distances. Review any added protection device with the load.

text.zh: 样品阶段核对插合、夹持、极性、导通和约定的电气检查，将确认结果写入图纸与检验文件。
text.en: Check mating, clamp handling, polarity, continuity and agreed electrical criteria at the sample stage; record approved results in drawings and inspection documents.

question.zh: 可以用于发动机跨接起动吗？
question.en: Is this a starter-motor jump lead?

answer.zh: 本页的用途范围为辅助供电与电池维护连接，启动机大电流不在已确认范围。需要跨接起动线时，应独立提供系统和电流工况，另行设计、选料与验证。
answer.en: This page covers auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside its confirmed scope. A jump-starting lead requires a separate system and electrical-duty review, followed by appropriate design, component selection and validation.

question.zh: 带有夹钳或保险座就能确定电流吗？
question.en: Do clamps or a fuse holder establish a current rating?

answer.zh: 载流要求须结合导体、接点、插头或插座、保护器件、长度和使用条件确认。照片中的夹钳大小或保险座外形不能提供整套组件的额定值。
answer.en: Establish electrical duty from the conductors, contacts, plug or socket, protection devices, length and operating conditions. Clamp size or fuse-holder appearance in a photograph does not provide an assembly rating.

question.zh: 连接线是否具有充电或升降压功能？
question.en: Does the lead provide charging or voltage conversion?

answer.zh: 本示例展示连接结构，不声明具备充电控制或升降压功能。连接维护充电器或辅助附件前，需要核对设备功能、供电方向、极性和输入输出要求。
answer.en: The example shows a connection assembly without a claim of charging control or voltage conversion. Before connecting maintenance equipment or an accessory, confirm equipment function, supply direction, polarity and input/output requirements.

text.en: This example is scoped to auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside the confirmed application scope. Confirm the load, voltage drop, component ratings and circuit protection for the project.

value.zh: 提供两端设备的输入或输出资料，确认电压、供电方向及允许使用方式。
value.en: Provide input/output data for the equipment at both ends; confirm voltage, supply direction and permitted use.

value.zh: 按附件或维护设备资料确定工作电流、使用时长及保护要求，不采用发动机起动电流作为本页选型依据。
value.en: Define current, operating duration and protection from accessory or maintenance-equipment data. Engine-starting current is outside this page’s selection scope.

label.zh: SAE式双极接口与对插尺寸
label.en: SAE-style two-pole interface and mating dimensions

value.zh: 以对插件资料核对尺寸、插合保持方式和正负极位置，外形接近仍需对插验证。
value.en: Check dimensions, mating retention and polarity against the mating component; verify the connection even when outlines appear similar.

value.zh: 确认目标接点、夹口范围、接触方式、正负标识及绝缘覆盖。
value.en: Confirm contact points, jaw range, contact arrangement, polarity marking and insulation coverage.

value.zh: 导体截面、总长度、压降及保险器件按实际辅助负载共同评审；具体额定以确认物料为准。
value.en: Review conductor size, total length, voltage drop and protection for the auxiliary load. Ratings depend on the approved components.

value.zh: 确认端头型号、回路图、极性、长度、物料表和检验点，再进行样品试装与重复制造。
value.en: Approve end-component references, circuit drawing, polarity, length, BOM and inspection points for sample fitting and repeat manufacture.

text.zh: 围绕电池维护设备的接入位置，确认正负极、夹钳操作空间和充电器接口。充电方式及允许电流由设备资料确定，线束本身不承担充电控制功能。
text.en: Plan access for battery-maintenance equipment around terminal polarity, clamp clearance and the charger interface. Charging method and permitted current come from the equipment documentation; the lead itself does not provide charging control.

text.zh: 用于讨论车内附件的辅助供电接口时，核对插头或插座形式、插合保持力和线长。先确认附件输入及车辆电源口要求，再选择导体与保护配置。
text.en: For a vehicle accessory interface, confirm the plug or socket form, mating retention and lead length. Establish the accessory input and vehicle outlet requirements before selecting conductors, circuit protection and the connection arrangement.

text.zh: 台架样品检查可围绕导通、极性、端头接触和项目要求的压降展开。测试电源须具备适合样品的控制条件，允许电气负载应先由图纸和器件资料确认。
text.en: Bench checks can cover continuity, polarity, terminal contact and the voltage-drop limits agreed for the project. Use a suitably controlled supply and confirm the permitted electrical duty from drawings and component data before testing.

text.zh: 车辆维护中的小型工具或附件接入，需要确认设备输入、接点、作业时长及安全放置位置。此方向用于辅助电源连接评审，不包含起动机跨接启动用途。
text.en: For small tools or accessories used during vehicle service, define the equipment input, connection points, operating duration and a secure lead position. This direction covers auxiliary supply review; starter-motor jump starting is outside its scope.

text.zh: 辅助回路的保险器件、导体、端头和负载应配套评审，保留检修及更换空间。是否配置保险座、器件型号和串联位置，需按具体结构与确认图纸确定。
text.en: Review protection devices, conductors, terminations and the accessory load together, allowing access for service and replacement. Confirm whether a fuse holder is included, its component reference and its circuit position from the actual construction and approved drawing.

text.zh: 车内或维修工位的辅助引线需避开锐边、活动件和受压位置，预留插拔空间。固定点、弯曲余量与实际长度应在样品试装时核对，不凭产品外观确定安装位置。
text.en: Route auxiliary leads clear of sharp edges, moving parts and pinch points in the vehicle or service area. Confirm fixing points, bend allowance, mating clearance and installed length during sample fitting rather than inferring the installation from appearance.

text.zh: 可围绕点烟器式或双极接口、夹钳接点和设备供电方向定义连接表，先确认两端资料。
text.en: Define the connection table around the outlet or two-pole interface, clamp contacts and equipment supply direction. Confirm data for both ends first.

text.zh: 按实际安装或操作距离安排导线、夹钳绝缘和保险座位置；需增加保护器件时同时审核器件与负载。
text.en: Arrange lead length, clamp insulation and fuse-holder location around installation or handling distances. Review any added protection device with the load.

text.zh: 样品阶段核对插合、夹持、极性、导通和约定的电气检查，将确认结果写入图纸与检验文件。
text.en: Check mating, clamp handling, polarity, continuity and agreed electrical criteria at the sample stage; record approved results in drawings and inspection documents.

question.zh: 可以用于发动机跨接起动吗？

answer.zh: 本页的用途范围为辅助供电与电池维护连接，启动机大电流不在已确认范围。需要跨接起动线时，应独立提供系统和电流工况，另行设计、选料与验证。
answer.en: This page covers auxiliary supply and battery-maintenance connections. Starter-motor current is outside its confirmed scope. A jump-starting lead requires a separate system and electrical-duty review, followed by appropriate design, component selection and validation.

question.en: Does the lead provide charging or voltage conversion?

answer.en: The example shows a connection assembly without a claim of charging control or voltage conversion. Before connecting maintenance equipment or an accessory, confirm equipment function, supply direction, polarity and input/output requirements.

text.zh: 端子孔径、紧固件、接触面和绝缘收口需配套确认。安装后预留引线弯曲和维护空间，避免端子承受线缆牵拉。
text.en: Confirm ring bore, fasteners, contact surface and insulation termination together. Allow lead bends and service access after installation without transferring cable pull to the ring ends.

text.zh: 图示保险座需与熔断器、导体和负载共同评审，确认保护位置、物料额定及更换空间。
text.en: Review the pictured holder with the fuse, conductors and load, confirming protection location, component ratings and replacement access.

label.zh: 控制器或维护设备资料

value.zh: 提供控制器电池端或维护设备的输入输出要求，区分电池侧和光伏串侧。
value.en: Provide controller battery-terminal or maintenance-equipment input/output requirements, distinguishing the battery side from the photovoltaic-string side.

value.zh: 电压体系、允许电流、供电方向及使用时长按实际设备与物料资料确认。
value.en: Confirm voltage system, permitted current, supply direction and operating duration from actual equipment and component data.

value.zh: 核对 XT60、SAE式或DC圆孔端的实际规格、对插件及正负极，不凭外形确定兼容。
value.en: Verify the actual XT60, SAE-style or barrel-interface specification, mating component and polarity; appearance does not establish compatibility.

value.zh: 有环形端子时核对孔径与紧固件；按引线路径安排固定、绝缘与弯曲余量。
value.en: Where ring ends are present, match bores and fasteners. Plan fixing, insulation and bend allowance around the routing path.

value.zh: 导体、总长度、压降及保险器件配套确认；带保险座样例的具体额定须核对物料。
value.en: Confirm conductors, total length, voltage drop and protection together. For examples with a fuse holder, verify component ratings.

value.zh: 批准回路表、尺寸、物料表和检验要求后制作样品，检查极性、导通、插合及装配。
value.en: Approve the circuit table, dimensions, BOM and inspection requirements for samples, then check polarity, continuity, mating and assembly.

text.zh: 太阳能控制器的电池侧接线需按控制器电池端、蓄电池端和保护要求确认。此方向讨论低压电池连接，不将图示接口作为光伏组件串侧接口使用。
text.en: For the battery side of a solar controller, confirm the controller battery terminals, battery connections and protection requirements from equipment data. This direction concerns low-voltage battery connections; it does not establish a photovoltaic-string connection.

text.zh: 维护设备的可拆引线需要确认设备端接口、正负极和使用时长。环形端子是否长期固定、插接端是否需带盖，都应在安装要求与样品阶段明确。
text.en: For detachable maintenance leads, define the equipment interface, polarity and operating duration. Confirm whether ring ends remain installed and whether the plug-in end needs a cover, then check access and handling during sampling.

text.zh: 接口转接应按两端设备输入输出资料建立回路表。XT60、SAE式接口或DC圆孔端的形状不能代替极性、允许电流、供电方向和保护配置确认。
text.en: Create a connection table from the input/output data of both devices for a DC accessory adapter. The XT60, SAE-style or barrel-interface form does not replace checks of polarity, permitted current, supply direction and circuit protection.

text.zh: 带保险座的结构需要把熔断器、保险座、导体和设备负载作为整套回路评审。明确保护器件位置及维护空间，实际额定值以确认物料和项目工况为准。
text.en: For a lead with a fuse holder, review the fuse, holder, conductors and equipment load as a complete circuit. Define protection-device location and service access; ratings depend on the approved components and electrical duty.

text.zh: 辅助配电的固定点、端子接触面、绝缘覆盖和引线路径应按设备图纸安排。环形端子孔径与紧固件需成套核对，不根据线缆外径推定使用能力。
text.en: Arrange fixing points, terminal contact surfaces, insulation coverage and routing from the equipment drawing for auxiliary distribution. Match ring bores to their fasteners as a set; cable outside diameter does not establish electrical capability.

text.zh: 样品可按项目确认导通、极性、插合、保险座操作和约定电气负载下的表现。测试限值与接入设备应记录，不能只以连接器能插合判断可投入使用。
text.en: Check continuity, polarity, mating, fuse-holder access and behavior under the agreed electrical duty during sampling. Record the test limits and connected equipment; a connector that can mate does not by itself establish suitability for service.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为低压电池侧、辅助供电与维护接入的项目方向。实际设备及接口需要确认，本示例不声明适用于光伏串侧或起动机回路。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions concern low-voltage battery-side, auxiliary-supply and maintenance connections. Confirm actual equipment and interfaces; photovoltaic-string or starter-circuit suitability is not claimed.

text.zh: 按设备接口图纸确认双极接口、圆孔端或环形端子配置，建立完整正负极与回路对应关系。
text.en: Confirm two-pole, barrel or ring-terminal arrangements from equipment interface drawings and create a complete polarity and circuit mapping.

text.zh: 围绕实际距离、固定点和维修位置安排线长、绝缘与保险座，具体物料按电气工况选配。
text.en: Arrange length, insulation and fuse holders around actual distances, fixing points and service positions. Select components for the electrical duty.

text.zh: 样品通过接口、极性、导通及约定负载检查后，按确认版本的图纸、物料表和检验文件组织制造。
text.en: After sample checks of interfaces, polarity, continuity and agreed load conditions, manufacture from the approved drawing, BOM and inspection revision.

question.zh: 这类线可以直接用于光伏组件串侧吗？
question.en: Is this a photovoltaic-string cable?

answer.zh: 本页讨论低压电池侧与维护连接。光伏串侧的连接器、电压、绝缘及环境要求需独立评审，不能从 SAE、XT60 或DC圆孔端外观推定满足。
answer.en: This page concerns low-voltage battery-side and maintenance connections. Photovoltaic-string connectors, voltage, insulation and exposure require separate review; an SAE-style, XT60 or barrel-interface form does not establish those requirements.

question.zh: 可以用于启动机回路吗？
question.en: Can it be selected for a starter circuit?

answer.zh: 启动机大电流不在本页确认范围。需要起动回路时，应另行提供系统、负载及安装工况，独立设计、选料与验证。
answer.en: Starter-current duty is outside the confirmed scope of this page. Supply the system, load and installation conditions for a separate starter-circuit design, component selection and validation.

question.zh: 接口能插合就能接入设备吗？
question.en: Does mating alone establish equipment compatibility?

answer.zh: 仍需核对接口实际规格、正负极、供电方向、允许负载及保护配置。带保险座也不能代替整套回路的额定和工况确认。
answer.en: Verify the actual interface specification, polarity, supply direction, permitted load and protection. A fuse holder does not replace confirmation of the complete circuit rating and operating conditions.

value.en: Confirm conductors, total length, voltage drop and protection together. For examples with a fuse holder, verify component ratings.

value.zh: 批准回路表、尺寸、物料表和检验要求后制作样品，检查极性、导通、插合及装配。
value.en: Approve the circuit table, dimensions, BOM and inspection requirements for samples, then check polarity, continuity, mating and assembly.

text.zh: 太阳能控制器的电池侧接线需按控制器电池端、蓄电池端和保护要求确认。此方向讨论低压电池连接，不将图示接口作为光伏组件串侧接口使用。
text.en: For the battery side of a solar controller, confirm the controller battery terminals, battery connections and protection requirements from equipment data. This direction concerns low-voltage battery connections; it does not establish a photovoltaic-string connection.

text.zh: 维护设备的可拆引线需要确认设备端接口、正负极和使用时长。环形端子是否长期固定、插接端是否需带盖，都应在安装要求与样品阶段明确。
text.en: For detachable maintenance leads, define the equipment interface, polarity and operating duration. Confirm whether ring ends remain installed and whether the plug-in end needs a cover, then check access and handling during sampling.

text.zh: 接口转接应按两端设备输入输出资料建立回路表。XT60、SAE式接口或DC圆孔端的形状不能代替极性、允许电流、供电方向和保护配置确认。
text.en: Create a connection table from the input/output data of both devices for a DC accessory adapter. The XT60, SAE-style or barrel-interface form does not replace checks of polarity, permitted current, supply direction and circuit protection.

text.zh: 带保险座的结构需要把熔断器、保险座、导体和设备负载作为整套回路评审。明确保护器件位置及维护空间，实际额定值以确认物料和项目工况为准。
text.en: For a lead with a fuse holder, review the fuse, holder, conductors and equipment load as a complete circuit. Define protection-device location and service access; ratings depend on the approved components and electrical duty.

text.zh: 辅助配电的固定点、端子接触面、绝缘覆盖和引线路径应按设备图纸安排。环形端子孔径与紧固件需成套核对，不根据线缆外径推定使用能力。
text.en: Arrange fixing points, terminal contact surfaces, insulation coverage and routing from the equipment drawing for auxiliary distribution. Match ring bores to their fasteners as a set; cable outside diameter does not establish electrical capability.

text.zh: 样品可按项目确认导通、极性、插合、保险座操作和约定电气负载下的表现。测试限值与接入设备应记录，不能只以连接器能插合判断可投入使用。
text.en: Check continuity, polarity, mating, fuse-holder access and behavior under the agreed electrical duty during sampling. Record the test limits and connected equipment; a connector that can mate does not by itself establish suitability for service.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为低压电池侧、辅助供电与维护接入的项目方向。实际设备及接口需要确认，本示例不声明适用于光伏串侧或起动机回路。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions concern low-voltage battery-side, auxiliary-supply and maintenance connections. Confirm actual equipment and interfaces; photovoltaic-string or starter-circuit suitability is not claimed.

text.zh: 按设备接口图纸确认双极接口、圆孔端或环形端子配置，建立完整正负极与回路对应关系。
text.en: Confirm two-pole, barrel or ring-terminal arrangements from equipment interface drawings and create a complete polarity and circuit mapping.

text.zh: 围绕实际距离、固定点和维修位置安排线长、绝缘与保险座，具体物料按电气工况选配。
text.en: Arrange length, insulation and fuse holders around actual distances, fixing points and service positions. Select components for the electrical duty.

text.zh: 样品通过接口、极性、导通及约定负载检查后，按确认版本的图纸、物料表和检验文件组织制造。
text.en: After sample checks of interfaces, polarity, continuity and agreed load conditions, manufacture from the approved drawing, BOM and inspection revision.

question.zh: 这类线可以直接用于光伏组件串侧吗？
question.en: Is this a photovoltaic-string cable?

answer.zh: 本页讨论低压电池侧与维护连接。光伏串侧的连接器、电压、绝缘及环境要求需独立评审，不能从 SAE、XT60 或DC圆孔端外观推定满足。
answer.en: This page concerns low-voltage battery-side and maintenance connections. Photovoltaic-string connectors, voltage, insulation and exposure require separate review; an SAE-style, XT60 or barrel-interface form does not establish those requirements.

question.zh: 可以用于启动机回路吗？
question.en: Can it be selected for a starter circuit?

answer.zh: 启动机大电流不在本页确认范围。需要起动回路时，应另行提供系统、负载及安装工况，独立设计、选料与验证。
answer.en: Starter-current duty is outside the confirmed scope of this page. Supply the system, load and installation conditions for a separate starter-circuit design, component selection and validation.

question.zh: 接口能插合就能接入设备吗？
question.en: Does mating alone establish equipment compatibility?

answer.zh: 仍需核对接口实际规格、正负极、供电方向、允许负载及保护配置。带保险座也不能代替整套回路的额定和工况确认。
answer.en: Verify the actual interface specification, polarity, supply direction, permitted load and protection. A fuse holder does not replace confirmation of the complete circuit rating and operating conditions.

structureIntro.zh: 以图示接口、引线及可见端部结构为依据，确认低压电池侧与维护连接的设计要点。

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech 中国工厂围绕低压电池侧、辅助电源与维护连接项目提供定制线束制造及 OEM/ODM 支持。以接口、极性、物料、线长和保护配置为依据，组织样品确认与受控制造。
text.en: Our China factory supports low-voltage battery-side, auxiliary-power and maintenance projects through custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM development. Interfaces, polarity, components, lead length and protection guide sample approval and controlled manufacture.

title.zh: 确认电池侧或维护设备的接口
title.en: Define the battery-side or maintenance interface

text.zh: 请提供控制器或维护设备资料、两端接口与极性、目标电压及负载、线长、端子和保护配置，以便开展选配和样品评审。

metaDescription.en: DC Barrel Plug with Fuse Holder Ring-Terminal Harness: low-voltage battery-side interfaces, polarity and protection. China factory for custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support.

lede.zh: 图示 eDP 屏线包含两个低矮连接端和扁平包覆走线段。主板、面板与整机版本资料是接口、信号通道、供电及安装尺寸的确认依据。
lede.en: The pictured eDP display cable has two low-profile connection ends and a flat covered routing section. Board, panel and system-revision data guide interface, lane, power and installation-dimension review.

quickPoints.zh: 目标主板与面板样品验证
quickPoints.en: Sample validation on the target board and panel

structureIntro.zh: 围绕图示屏线的低矮端头、包覆段和出线方向，按目标主板与面板资料确认连接。
structureIntro.en: Review the low-profile ends, covered section and cable exits against the target board and panel documentation.

text.zh: 实拍可见两端采用低矮接口结构。每端对应的板端或屏端型号、接触面和插入方向需由连接器图纸确认。
text.en: Both ends have a low-profile form in the photograph. Confirm the board or panel reference, contact face and insertion direction for each end from connector drawings.

text.zh: 包覆走线段需要与设备内部间隙、固定点和装配顺序配合。材料、厚度与屏蔽方式按物料资料确认。
text.en: Match the covered section to internal clearance, fixing points and assembly sequence. Confirm material, thickness and shielding from component documentation.

text.zh: 依据主板与面板资料确认主链路、辅助通信及电源接地针位，不能只按针数套用其他屏线的连接表。
text.en: Use board and panel documentation to define main-link, auxiliary-communication, power and ground assignments. Contact count alone does not establish the mapping of another display cable.

text.zh: 确认端头方向、包覆过渡位置和弯曲余量。机壳活动部位需另行评审，避免把拉力传至连接器接点。
text.en: Confirm end orientation, covered-section transitions and bend allowance. Review any moving enclosure parts separately to avoid transferring loads to connector contacts.

value.zh: 提供主板及面板完整型号、整机版本和接口图纸，再确认屏线是否适用。
value.en: Provide full board/panel references, system revision and interface drawings before confirming cable suitability.

label.en: eDP lanes and complete pin table

value.zh: 按设备资料确认信号通道、辅助通信、电源及接地，保留完整回路对应关系。
value.en: Define lanes, auxiliary communication, power and ground from equipment data; retain a complete contact mapping.

label.zh: 两端连接器与插入方向

value.zh: 核对连接器系列、接触面、保持方式、出线角度与插拔空间。
value.en: Check connector series, contact face, retention, cable-exit angle and mating clearance.

value.zh: 线长、包覆材料、厚度、屏蔽与固定按实际机壳及物料要求确定。
value.en: Set length, covering material, thickness, shielding and fixing from the enclosure and component requirements.

value.zh: 背光、触摸或控制信号是否包含在本线缆内，以面板与主板针脚资料为准。
value.en: Establish whether backlight, touch or control circuits are present from the panel and board pin tables.

value.zh: 明确导通、针位、装机显示、干扰及运动工况等需验收项目与限值。
value.en: Agree checks and limits for continuity, contact mapping, installed display behavior, interference and any mechanical motion.

text.zh: 目标主板与显示面板采用 eDP 接口时，应按双方资料确认完整针脚表、信号通道、供电与接地。线长和端头方向随实际机壳确定，不凭代号推定整机兼容。
text.en: Where the target board and display panel use eDP, confirm the complete pin table, lanes, power and ground from both sets of documentation. Set length and end orientation from the enclosure; the cable code alone does not establish system fit.

text.zh: 显示板附近的低矮连接端需核对系列、接触面、插入方向和保持方式。线缆与板端的装配间隙及拔插空间，需按目标 eDP 接口资料与实际机壳确认。
text.en: Review connector series, contact face, insertion direction and retention around the display board. Confirm cable-to-board assembly clearance and removal space from the target eDP interface documentation and actual enclosure.

text.zh: 在人机界面设备采用 eDP 显示链路时，协调屏端空间、主板位置、走线固定和装配顺序。触摸、背光及其他回路分别按设备资料定义，不默认由本屏线承载。
text.en: For an HMI that uses an eDP display link, coordinate panel clearance, board position, lead fixing and assembly sequence. Define touch, backlight and other circuits from equipment data; their presence on this cable is not assumed.

text.zh: 维修更换需要核对整机版本、面板型号、连接器及完整针脚关系。外部显示接口或屏幕尺寸不能证明内部屏线适配，应在装机前完成接口与走线确认。
text.en: For display-equipment replacement work, verify system revision, panel reference, connectors and the complete pin mapping. External display ports or screen size do not establish internal-cable fit; confirm the interfaces and routing before assembly.

text.zh: 屏线样品除导通与针位检查外，还需按项目要求在目标主板和面板上确认显示表现。测试条件、线长、屏蔽接地与验收限值应记录，本页不提供未经验证的传输指标。
text.en: Validate sample display behavior on the target board and panel as well as checking continuity and contact mapping. Record test conditions, length, shield grounding and acceptance limits; this page does not assign an unverified transmission specification.

text.zh: 薄型屏线的包覆段与端头需要安排弯曲余量、固定位置和应力释放。结合实际机壳检查装配顺序及运动部位，避免把屏端接头作为牵拉固定点。
text.en: Plan bend allowance, fixing positions and strain relief for the covered cable section and low-profile ends. Review assembly sequence and moving parts in the actual enclosure, keeping installation loads away from the panel connector.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为采用 eDP 显示链路时可讨论的设计与装配方向。内部接口、安装路径及屏线适配性以实际设备资料和样品确认为依据。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions concern equipment using an eDP display link. Establish the internal interface, routing and cable fit from actual equipment documentation and sample review.

text.zh: 基于目标主板与面板的连接器图纸建立针位表，明确主链路、辅助通信及供电接地。
text.en: Create a pin table from the target board and panel connector drawings, defining the main link, auxiliary communication, power and ground.

text.zh: 按固定点、转折位置和装配顺序确定长度与包覆段，保留插拔和弯曲空间。
text.en: Define length and covering around fixing points, bends and assembly sequence, allowing mating and bend clearance.

text.zh: 在目标设备上确认样品表现，再将接口、物料、尺寸和验收要求固化到制造文件。
text.en: Validate the sample in the target equipment before releasing interfaces, materials, dimensions and acceptance criteria to manufacturing documents.

question.zh: 可以直接替换外形相近的LVDS屏线吗？
question.en: Can it replace a similar-looking LVDS display cable?

answer.zh: eDP 与 LVDS 的链路及针位要求须分别确认。接头外形和针数相近不能证明可互换，本组件不声明提供协议转换功能。
answer.en: Confirm eDP and LVDS link and pin-mapping requirements separately. Similar connector outlines or contact counts do not establish interchangeability. No protocol-conversion function is claimed for this assembly.

question.zh: DC02002LM00或BCV10代号能确定整机适配吗？
question.en: Do DC02002LM00 or BCV10 identify a confirmed system fit?

answer.zh: 还需核对主板与面板型号、整机版本、两端连接器和完整针脚表。型号代号与外观可以辅助识别，装机适配须按实际资料及样品确认。
answer.en: Confirm board and panel references, system revision, both connectors and the complete pin table. A code and appearance help identify the example; establish system fit from documentation and sample validation.

question.zh: 样品阶段需要检查什么？
question.en: What should be checked during sampling?

answer.zh: 先核对接口、针位、导通、长度及装配，再按项目要求在目标设备上检查显示表现、屏蔽接地和机械工况。测试条件与限值应形成受控记录。
answer.en: Check interfaces, mapping, continuity, length and assembly first. Then verify display behavior, shield grounding and mechanical conditions in the target equipment to agreed project criteria, recording the test conditions and limits.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 定制线束制造
title.en: Custom wire harness manufacturing in China

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech 中国工厂为显示接口连接项目提供定制线束制造与 OEM/ODM 支持。以主板和面板接口、针脚表、走线尺寸及验收要求为基础，组织样品确认和受控制造。
text.en: Our China factory supports display-interface projects through custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM development. Board and panel interfaces, pin tables, routing dimensions and acceptance criteria guide sample approval and controlled manufacture.

title.zh: 从主板与面板资料开始
title.en: Start with board and panel documentation

text.zh: 请提供主板与面板型号、连接器和针脚表、目标长度、包覆与走线要求，以及样品需验证的显示工况。
text.en: Share board and panel references, connectors, pin tables, target length, covering and routing requirements, and the display conditions to validate in the sample.

metaDescription.zh: DC02002LM00 BCV10 eDP屏线：主板与面板接口、针脚及薄型走线评审。中国工厂提供定制线束制造和 OEM/ODM 支持。
metaDescription.en: DC02002LM00 BCV10 eDP display cable: board/panel interfaces, pin mapping and routing review. China factory for custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM support.

lede.zh: 红白引线通过集中束线段连接到分散金属端头，适合围绕Pt100接口项目整理通道、引线组与安装位置。感温元件的所在位置及线制按设备资料定义。
lede.en: Red and white leads pass through a gathered section to separate metal ends, providing a starting point for Pt100 interface channel groups and mounting positions. Define the element location and wiring scheme from equipment documents.

quickPoints.en: Acceptance for the complete measurement chain

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 红白引线通过集中束线段连接到分散金属端头，适合围绕Pt100接口项目整理通道、引线组与安装位置。感温元件的所在位置及线制按设备资料定义。
text.en: Red and white leads pass through a gathered section to separate metal ends, providing a starting point for Pt100 interface channel groups and mounting positions. Define the element location and wiring scheme from equipment documents.

text.zh: 金属端部可见安装孔，具体用于感温安装、电气接入还是固定，应与设备图纸中的端部功能对应。
text.en: Mounting holes are visible in the metal ends. Match their sensor-mounting, electrical-entry or retention function to the equipment drawing.

text.zh: 引线上的标识位置可与测点及采集通道表对应，同一温阻元件的引线组需保持可识别。
text.en: Lead identification can follow the sensing-point and acquisition-channel map. Keep the lead group from each RTD element identifiable.

value.zh: 提供Pt100元件规范、特性曲线与仪表输入资料；元件的容差等级和供货范围按项目BOM确认，不由连接线外观赋予。
value.en: Provide the Pt100 element specification, characteristic curve and instrument-input documents. Confirm element tolerance and supply scope in the project BOM; lead appearance does not establish them.

value.zh: 按仪表支持的接法定义实际线制与端口视图；不要由外部引线总数直接推断每个温阻通道的接法。
value.en: Define the actual wiring scheme and port view from the instrument-supported connection. Overall lead count does not establish the wiring of each RTD channel.

value.zh: 确认线长、截面及端接电阻对测量的影响。三线补偿需考虑引线电阻匹配，四线接法分别定义激励和电压测量路径。
value.en: Review the effects of lead length, size and termination resistance. Three-wire compensation depends on lead-resistance matching; four-wire connections define excitation and voltage-sensing paths separately.

value.zh: 逐路记录感温元件位置、引线编号、插头或端头对应及采集通道，分清同一元件的多根引线与不同测点的独立通道。
value.en: Record element positions, lead IDs, plug or end mapping and acquisition channels. Distinguish multiple leads from one element from independent channels at different sensing points.

value.zh: 用图纸确认金属端部的孔径、功能及固定方式，明确感温元件是否位于该部位；机械安装与电气接点分别定义。
value.en: Use drawings to define metal-end hole dimensions, function and retention. Establish whether the sensing element is at that position, defining mechanical mounting and electrical contacts separately.

value.zh: 按测点、过渡段和仪表区分别选择引线绝缘、保护与固定，确认热源距离、介质暴露和屏蔽安排，不把元件量程当作整条线的耐温。
value.en: Select insulation, protection and retention for sensing, transition and instrument areas. Review heat-source clearance, exposure and shielding; element range does not establish the entire lead temperature capability.

value.zh: 约定接线、电阻与安装检查，以及所需温度比对或校准范围；测量精度由元件、引线、仪表和安装共同验证。
value.en: Agree wiring, resistance and installation checks, plus any temperature-comparison or calibration scope. Verify measurement accuracy across the element, leads, instrument and installation together.

text.zh: 热工设备外围采用温阻测量时，先确定测点位置、元件温区和引线路径。Pt100元件、安装接触与仪表线制共同影响测量结果，外围引线不能按炉内温度直接选型。
text.en: For RTD measurement around thermal equipment, define sensing position, element exposure and lead route. The Pt100 element, mounting contact and instrument wiring scheme all affect the result; select peripheral leads for their own temperature zone rather than the furnace interior.

text.zh: 温控腔体的温阻反馈需按采集模块选择二、三或四线连接，并区分腔内与腔外引线条件。更改线长、接头或接线方式后，重新评估引线电阻与系统验收要求。
text.en: For RTD feedback from controlled chambers, choose two-, three- or four-wire connections to match the acquisition module and distinguish internal from external lead conditions. Changes to lengths, connectors or wiring require a new review of lead resistance and system acceptance.

text.zh: 加热设备的温阻测点需先明确元件位置、安装接触与实际温区，再安排引线过渡和应力支撑。感温段与引线段分别选材，接线与热区保护按温阻通道和仪表要求确认。
text.en: For RTD sensing around heating equipment, define the element position, mounting contact and actual temperature zone before arranging lead transitions and support. Select sensing and lead-section materials separately, and define wiring and thermal protection for the RTD channel and instrument.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备的测温连接需区分感温段、腔体穿出位置和控制端接入。采用温阻输入的项目，按仪表规定线制整理引线与通道；连接器、端接和线长更改后重新确认整条测量链路。
text.en: For commercial heating equipment, distinguish the sensing section, chamber exit and controller entry. In projects using RTD inputs, organize leads and channels for the instrument wiring scheme, and review the full measurement chain after changes to connectors, terminations or length.

title.en: Appliance temperature control and service interfaces

text.zh: 采用温阻传感器的家电项目，可围绕加热或冷却模块安排测温引线及检修接口。先区分感温元件与连接线的供货范围，再确认热区保护、连接表和维护长度。
text.en: For appliance projects using RTDs, route sensing leads and service interfaces around heating or cooling modules. Define whether the sensing element is included with the lead assembly, then confirm thermal-zone protection, the connection map and service lengths.

title.zh: 发动机外围温度监测项目

text.zh: 发动机外围如采用温阻监测，应先定义具体测点和元件温区，结合热源、流体与振动安排引线。线制、接口和安装位置按项目图纸确认，线束结构本身不代表已适配某个发动机或车型。
text.en: For projects using RTDs around an engine, define sensing points and element temperature zones before routing leads around heat sources, fluids and vibration. Confirm wiring scheme, interfaces and mounting from project drawings; harness form alone does not establish fitment to an engine or vehicle.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为围绕温度测点、热区与仪表的连接方向。传感器类型、使用温区及测量验收按具体设备项目确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover temperature sensing points, thermal zones and instruments. Define sensor type, temperature exposure and measurement acceptance for the specific equipment project.

text.zh: 按仪表接法整理二、三或四线连接，明确每个感温元件的引线组、接口位置及通道编号，避免把多测点误接为同一元件。
text.en: Define two-, three- or four-wire connections from the instrument scheme, identifying each element lead group, interface position and channel ID to keep distinct sensing points separate.

text.zh: 按测点与模块位置配置长度、截面、分支和端头；带孔金属部位的用途、安装尺寸与保护方式用图纸确认。
text.en: Configure lengths, conductor size, branches and ends around sensing and module positions. Confirm the function, dimensions and protection of holed metal sections in drawings.

text.zh: 以确认BOM与连接表核对样品，约定引线电阻及安装检查；需要整机温度比对时，再明确元件、仪表、方法和报告的边界。
text.en: Check samples against the approved BOM and connection map, with agreed lead-resistance and installation checks. For system temperature comparisons, define the element, instrument, method and reporting scope separately.

question.zh: 二、三、四线温阻接法能直接互换吗？
question.en: Are two-, three- and four-wire RTD connections interchangeable?

answer.zh: 需与仪表的激励和测量接法匹配。二线读数包含引线影响；三线关注引线匹配；四线分开激励与测量，改接后仍需按整条测量链路验证。
answer.en: Match the instrument excitation and sensing scheme. Two-wire readings include lead effects, three-wire arrangements depend on matching, and four-wire arrangements separate excitation and sensing. Validate the complete chain after changing the connection.

question.zh: 环形金属端部是否就是感温元件？
question.en: Is the ring-shaped metal end the sensing element?

answer.zh: 照片不能说明内部元件位置。需用图纸区分感温安装部位、电气端头和普通固定件，并明确Pt100元件是否随线束一同提供。
answer.en: The photograph does not establish the internal element position. Use drawings to distinguish sensor mounting, electrical ends and ordinary retention, and define whether the Pt100 element is supplied with the harness.

question.zh: 更改引线长度后，精度还能直接沿用吗？
question.en: Can accuracy remain unchanged after altering lead length?

answer.zh: 需要重新评估引线及端接电阻、线制、仪表补偿和安装条件。组件尺寸确认与温度校准分开约定，不能把原元件等级直接当作整条测量链路精度。
answer.en: Review lead and termination resistance, wiring scheme, instrument compensation and installation again. Define dimensional approval separately from temperature calibration; element grade alone does not establish complete-chain accuracy.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 测温连接项目支持

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM项目支持。测温连接先明确传感器与引线供货范围，再按确认材料、连接表和尺寸组织样品；温度比对、校准及完整系统验证的执行范围与报告要求单独约定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. Define sensor and lead supply scope before sampling against approved materials, connection maps and dimensions. Agree temperature comparison, calibration, complete-system validation and reporting scope separately.

title.zh: 从测点与仪表输入开始
title.en: Start with sensing points and instrument inputs

text.zh: 提供传感器及仪表型号、测点温区、连接表、安装方式和目标长度；温阻补充线制，热电偶补充分度、材料与参考接点要求。
text.en: Share sensor and instrument models, sensing temperature zones, connection maps, mounting and target lengths. For RTDs, include the wiring scheme; for thermocouples, include type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

lede.zh: 双端微型热电偶形式接头通过细线段连接，适合讨论K型测温链路的可拆延伸。端头极性、接点材料和线段长度需与传感器及仪表方案对应。
lede.en: Miniature thermocouple-form ends are linked by fine cable for a removable extension in a Type K measurement chain. Match end polarity, contact materials and cable length to the sensor and instrument plan.

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 两端设置微型插接端头，便于把测温延长段作为独立线段安排安装和拆卸。对插与极性按完整接口资料确认。
text.en: Miniature mating ends let the temperature extension be arranged as a removable section. Define mating and polarity from complete interface documents.

text.zh: 两端之间是一段连续细线，可围绕传感器到仪表的位置安排长度、固定和端头后方的弯曲空间。
text.en: A continuous fine-cable section links the ends. Set length, supports and bends behind the ends around sensor and instrument positions.

title.en: Defined materials through the measurement path

text.zh: 连接器触点与线材材料需一起纳入热电偶链路定义，避免只确认端头外形而遗漏材料转换和参考接点。
text.en: Define connector-contact and cable materials together within the thermocouple chain, including material transitions and the reference junction as well as end form.

label.zh: 热电偶分度与接入任务

value.zh: 记录热电偶分度、传感器与仪表输入资料，区分探头引线、延长线与补偿段。K型项目按对应材料体系定义，不以黄色外观单独认定。
value.en: Record thermocouple type and sensor and instrument-input documents. Distinguish probe leads, extension leads and compensating sections. Use the matching material system for Type K; yellow appearance alone does not identify it.

value.zh: 逐端定义正负极、接口位置与测量通道编号，核对连接器触点材料和极性标识采用的规范。
value.en: Define positive and negative leads, interface positions and channel IDs at each end. Confirm connector-contact materials and the convention used for polarity marks.

value.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径按分度与各段温度选择规定材料，不直接用普通铜线替代指定热电偶延长或补偿材料。
value.en: Select specified materials from the measuring junction to the reference junction for the thermocouple type and each temperature zone. Do not directly substitute ordinary copper for specified thermocouple extension or compensating material.

value.zh: 明确异种材料转换位置、参考接点所在温区及仪表的冷端补偿安排；接头、端子排与柜内温差一并纳入测量链路评审。
value.en: Define material-transition locations, the reference-junction temperature zone and the instrument cold-junction compensation arrangement. Include connectors, terminal blocks and cabinet temperature differences in the measurement-chain review.

value.zh: 确认结点位置、露出或护套结构、接地或隔离要求，并与测点接触、响应要求及实际安装结构对应。
value.en: Confirm junction position, exposed or sheathed construction, and grounding or isolation requirements against sensing contact, response needs and the actual installation.

value.zh: 分别定义探头段和延长段长度、材料及温区，确认弯曲、固定和端头防拉扯；编织外观不代表已确认的绝缘材料或温度等级。
value.en: Define lengths, materials and temperature zones separately for probe and extension sections. Confirm bending, supports and strain relief; braided appearance does not establish insulation material or temperature rating.

value.zh: 样品核对物料、极性、连接表与尺寸；如需温度比对或校准，另约定设备、方法、整条测量链路范围与报告责任。
value.en: Check materials, polarity, connection maps and dimensions in the sample. If temperature comparison or calibration is required, agree equipment, method, measurement-chain scope and reporting responsibility separately.

text.zh: 热工设备外围的测温引线需按实际测点温区、热辐射与固定路径选择结构。热电偶分度、结点形式和仪表输入共同定义测量链路，不能把引线绝缘的耐温直接当作探头量程。
text.en: Around thermal equipment, select lead construction from the actual sensing zone, radiant heat and support route. Thermocouple type, junction form and instrument input define the measurement chain; insulation temperature capability does not establish the probe measurement range.

text.zh: 烘炉或温控腔体的测温连接需区分腔内测点、穿出位置与腔外仪表区。按各段温度和接线方式安排延长或补偿材料，把参考接点位置纳入系统记录。
text.en: Temperature connections for furnaces or controlled chambers need separate definitions for the sensing point, cable passage and external instrument area. Select extension or compensating materials for each section and record the reference-junction position within the system.

title.zh: 热电偶探头与局部测点
title.en: Thermocouple probes and local sensing points

text.zh: 热电偶引线可按探头与仪表之间的距离配置，先确认探头分度、接口极性和测点固定，再安排延长段。杆式或细线结点采用的接触方式与使用温区，按具体探头和设备资料定义。
text.en: Configure thermocouple leads for the distance between probe and instrument, confirming probe type, interface polarity and sensing-point retention before planning the extension. Define contact arrangements and temperature zones for stem probes or fine-wire junctions from the specific probe and equipment documents.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备采用热电偶输入时，探头、延长段与温控仪表需保持分度和极性对应。腔体内外的材料转换、参考接点和冷端补偿按设备方案确认，避免把仪表环境温度当作测点温度。
text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. Define material transitions, the reference junction and cold-junction compensation across the chamber boundary from the equipment design, distinguishing instrument ambient temperature from the sensing point.

text.zh: 家电采用热电偶测温的项目，需分别确认传感器、温控模块及可拆接口。引线经过加热区、机壳和维修位置时，各段材料、固定和接点要求按设备资料安排。
text.en: For appliance projects using thermocouples, define the sensor, temperature-control module and removable interfaces separately. Plan materials, retention and junction requirements for leads passing through heated areas, the enclosure and service positions from equipment documents.

title.zh: 发动机外围温度监测项目

text.zh: 发动机外围的热电偶测温项目，需把实际测点、探头结构和引线经过的温区分开定义。按具体分度、接口与固定路径配置连接，并将参考接点和仪表区的热环境纳入验证。
text.en: For thermocouple projects around an engine, define the sensing point, probe construction and temperature zones along the lead separately. Configure the connection for the specified type, interfaces and support route, and include reference-junction and instrument-area thermal conditions in validation.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为围绕温度测点、热区与仪表的连接方向。传感器类型、使用温区及测量验收按具体设备项目确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover temperature sensing points, thermal zones and instruments. Define sensor type, temperature exposure and measurement acceptance for the specific equipment project.

text.zh: 把热电偶分度、延长或补偿材料、端头触点和绝缘分段写入BOM；不同温区的材料边界在装配图中标明。
text.en: Put thermocouple type, extension or compensating materials, end contacts and insulation sections in the BOM. Mark material boundaries across temperature zones in the assembly drawing.

text.zh: 围绕传感器与仪表位置安排线长、端头朝向和标签，使正负极、测点编号与采集通道可逐路核对。
text.en: Set length, end direction and labels around sensor and instrument positions, keeping polarity, sensing-point IDs and acquisition channels traceable in the connection map.

text.zh: 样品先确认结构、物料和接线；参考接点、冷端补偿与温度校准属于整条测量链路的要求，执行范围及记录在项目中约定。
text.en: Confirm structure, materials and wiring at sample review. Treat reference junctions, cold-junction compensation and temperature calibration as measurement-chain requirements, with execution scope and records agreed for the project.

question.zh: 热电偶延长段可以直接换普通铜线吗？
question.en: Can an extension section use ordinary copper wire?

answer.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径需使用与分度及温区相符的规定材料。参考接点之后的连接由仪表设计决定，不能任意在原测量路径中改换铜线。
answer.en: Use the specified materials for the thermocouple type and temperature zones between the measuring and reference junctions. Connections beyond the reference junction follow the instrument design; do not replace sections arbitrarily with copper.

question.zh: 黄色接头是否足以确认K型与正负极？
question.en: Do yellow ends establish Type K and polarity?

answer.zh: 还需核对物料规范、触点材料、极性标识和所用色标规则。外观只帮助识别，不能代替分度与正负极连接表。
answer.en: Also check material specifications, contact materials, polarity marks and the color-code convention. Appearance aids identification but does not replace the thermocouple type and polarity map.

question.zh: 延长线本身是否包含冷端补偿？
question.en: Does an extension lead provide cold-junction compensation?

answer.zh: 延长线负责按规定材料和极性连接。参考接点与冷端补偿由仪表和接线结构定义，需连同传感器、端接和温区共同审核。
answer.en: The lead connects the specified materials with the correct polarity. The instrument and connection arrangement define the reference junction and cold-junction compensation, which need review with the sensor, terminations and temperature zones.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 测温连接项目支持

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM项目支持。测温连接先明确传感器与引线供货范围，再按确认材料、连接表和尺寸组织样品；温度比对、校准及完整系统验证的执行范围与报告要求单独约定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. Define sensor and lead supply scope before sampling against approved materials, connection maps and dimensions. Agree temperature comparison, calibration, complete-system validation and reporting scope separately.

title.zh: 从测点与仪表输入开始
title.en: Start with sensing points and instrument inputs

text.zh: 提供传感器及仪表型号、测点温区、连接表、安装方式和目标长度；温阻补充线制，热电偶补充分度、材料与参考接点要求。
text.en: Share sensor and instrument models, sensing temperature zones, connection maps, mounting and target lengths. For RTDs, include the wiring scheme; for thermocouples, include type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

lede.zh: 单端微型插接头与细引线、端部小结点组合，形成紧凑的K型测温接入形式。测点固定、正负极与参考接点边界需纳入同一连接方案。
lede.en: A miniature plug, fine leads and a small end junction form a compact Type K sensing connection. Coordinate sensing-point retention, polarity and the reference-junction boundary within one connection plan.

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 一端可见微型插接头，出线方向与插拔空间可结合仪表端口安排；正负极以接头资料和接线表核对。
text.en: A miniature plug is visible at one end. Arrange cable exit and mating clearance around the instrument port, checking polarity from connector documents and the wiring map.

text.zh: 细线另一端可见小结点，结点固定与测点接触需要避免拉力直接作用于细线接合部位。
text.en: A small junction is visible at the fine-wire end. Arrange contact and retention so installation loads do not act directly on the fine-wire joint.

text.zh: 细线段有外层保护纹理，实际材料、覆盖范围和温度条件按物料文件定义，再安排热区与仪表区之间的过渡。
text.en: The fine cable has a textured protective outer layer. Define its material, coverage and temperature conditions from material documents before arranging the transition between sensing and instrument zones.

label.zh: 热电偶分度与接入任务

value.zh: 记录热电偶分度、传感器与仪表输入资料，区分探头引线、延长线与补偿段。K型项目按对应材料体系定义，不以黄色外观单独认定。
value.en: Record thermocouple type and sensor and instrument-input documents. Distinguish probe leads, extension leads and compensating sections. Use the matching material system for Type K; yellow appearance alone does not identify it.

value.zh: 逐端定义正负极、接口位置与测量通道编号，核对连接器触点材料和极性标识采用的规范。
value.en: Define positive and negative leads, interface positions and channel IDs at each end. Confirm connector-contact materials and the convention used for polarity marks.

value.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径按分度与各段温度选择规定材料，不直接用普通铜线替代指定热电偶延长或补偿材料。
value.en: Select specified materials from the measuring junction to the reference junction for the thermocouple type and each temperature zone. Do not directly substitute ordinary copper for specified thermocouple extension or compensating material.

value.zh: 明确异种材料转换位置、参考接点所在温区及仪表的冷端补偿安排；接头、端子排与柜内温差一并纳入测量链路评审。
value.en: Define material-transition locations, the reference-junction temperature zone and the instrument cold-junction compensation arrangement. Include connectors, terminal blocks and cabinet temperature differences in the measurement-chain review.

value.zh: 确认结点位置、露出或护套结构、接地或隔离要求，并与测点接触、响应要求及实际安装结构对应。
value.en: Confirm junction position, exposed or sheathed construction, and grounding or isolation requirements against sensing contact, response needs and the actual installation.

value.zh: 分别定义探头段和延长段长度、材料及温区，确认弯曲、固定和端头防拉扯；编织外观不代表已确认的绝缘材料或温度等级。
value.en: Define lengths, materials and temperature zones separately for probe and extension sections. Confirm bending, supports and strain relief; braided appearance does not establish insulation material or temperature rating.

value.zh: 样品核对物料、极性、连接表与尺寸；如需温度比对或校准，另约定设备、方法、整条测量链路范围与报告责任。
value.en: Check materials, polarity, connection maps and dimensions in the sample. If temperature comparison or calibration is required, agree equipment, method, measurement-chain scope and reporting responsibility separately.

text.zh: 热工设备外围的测温引线需按实际测点温区、热辐射与固定路径选择结构。热电偶分度、结点形式和仪表输入共同定义测量链路，不能把引线绝缘的耐温直接当作探头量程。
text.en: Around thermal equipment, select lead construction from the actual sensing zone, radiant heat and support route. Thermocouple type, junction form and instrument input define the measurement chain; insulation temperature capability does not establish the probe measurement range.

text.zh: 烘炉或温控腔体的测温连接需区分腔内测点、穿出位置与腔外仪表区。按各段温度和接线方式安排延长或补偿材料，把参考接点位置纳入系统记录。
text.en: Temperature connections for furnaces or controlled chambers need separate definitions for the sensing point, cable passage and external instrument area. Select extension or compensating materials for each section and record the reference-junction position within the system.

title.zh: 热电偶探头与局部测点
title.en: Thermocouple probes and local sensing points

text.zh: 热电偶引线可按探头与仪表之间的距离配置，先确认探头分度、接口极性和测点固定，再安排延长段。杆式或细线结点采用的接触方式与使用温区，按具体探头和设备资料定义。
text.en: Configure thermocouple leads for the distance between probe and instrument, confirming probe type, interface polarity and sensing-point retention before planning the extension. Define contact arrangements and temperature zones for stem probes or fine-wire junctions from the specific probe and equipment documents.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备采用热电偶输入时，探头、延长段与温控仪表需保持分度和极性对应。腔体内外的材料转换、参考接点和冷端补偿按设备方案确认，避免把仪表环境温度当作测点温度。
text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. Define material transitions, the reference junction and cold-junction compensation across the chamber boundary from the equipment design, distinguishing instrument ambient temperature from the sensing point.

text.zh: 家电采用热电偶测温的项目，需分别确认传感器、温控模块及可拆接口。引线经过加热区、机壳和维修位置时，各段材料、固定和接点要求按设备资料安排。
text.en: For appliance projects using thermocouples, define the sensor, temperature-control module and removable interfaces separately. Plan materials, retention and junction requirements for leads passing through heated areas, the enclosure and service positions from equipment documents.

text.en: For thermocouple projects around an engine, define the sensing point, probe construction and temperature zones along the lead separately. Configure the connection for the specified type, interfaces and support route, and include reference-junction and instrument-area thermal conditions in validation.
