title.zh: 中国工厂 · 测温连接项目支持

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM项目支持。测温连接先明确传感器与引线供货范围，再按确认材料、连接表和尺寸组织样品；温度比对、校准及完整系统验证的执行范围与报告要求单独约定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. Define sensor and lead supply scope before sampling against approved materials, connection maps and dimensions. Agree temperature comparison, calibration, complete-system validation and reporting scope separately.

title.zh: 从测点与仪表输入开始
title.en: Start with sensing points and instrument inputs

text.zh: 提供传感器及仪表型号、测点温区、连接表、安装方式和目标长度；温阻补充线制，热电偶补充分度、材料与参考接点要求。
text.en: Share sensor and instrument models, sensing temperature zones, connection maps, mounting and target lengths. For RTDs, include the wiring scheme; for thermocouples, include type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

lede.zh: 集中束线段与带孔金属端部组成多端头连接形式，可围绕Pt100测温项目安排引线标识与端口对应。端部用途、元件供货范围和温区需分别明确。
lede.en: A gathered lead section and holed metal ends form a multi-end connection layout for Pt100 project identification and port mapping. Define end functions, element supply scope and temperature zones separately.

quickPoints.en: Acceptance for the complete measurement chain

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 集中束线段与带孔金属端部组成多端头连接形式，可围绕Pt100测温项目安排引线标识与端口对应。端部用途、元件供货范围和温区需分别明确。
text.en: A gathered lead section and holed metal ends form a multi-end connection layout for Pt100 project identification and port mapping. Define end functions, element supply scope and temperature zones separately.

text.zh: 金属端部可见安装孔，具体用于感温安装、电气接入还是固定，应与设备图纸中的端部功能对应。
text.en: Mounting holes are visible in the metal ends. Match their sensor-mounting, electrical-entry or retention function to the equipment drawing.

text.zh: 引线上的标识位置可与测点及采集通道表对应，同一温阻元件的引线组需保持可识别。
text.en: Lead identification can follow the sensing-point and acquisition-channel map. Keep the lead group from each RTD element identifiable.

value.zh: 提供Pt100元件规范、特性曲线与仪表输入资料；元件的容差等级和供货范围按项目BOM确认，不由连接线外观赋予。
value.en: Provide the Pt100 element specification, characteristic curve and instrument-input documents. Confirm element tolerance and supply scope in the project BOM; lead appearance does not establish them.

value.zh: 按仪表支持的接法定义实际线制与端口视图；不要由外部引线总数直接推断每个温阻通道的接法。
value.en: Define the actual wiring scheme and port view from the instrument-supported connection. Overall lead count does not establish the wiring of each RTD channel.

value.zh: 确认线长、截面及端接电阻对测量的影响。三线补偿需考虑引线电阻匹配，四线接法分别定义激励和电压测量路径。
value.en: Review the effects of lead length, size and termination resistance. Three-wire compensation depends on lead-resistance matching; four-wire connections define excitation and voltage-sensing paths separately.

value.zh: 逐路记录感温元件位置、引线编号、插头或端头对应及采集通道，分清同一元件的多根引线与不同测点的独立通道。
value.en: Record element positions, lead IDs, plug or end mapping and acquisition channels. Distinguish multiple leads from one element from independent channels at different sensing points.

value.zh: 用图纸确认金属端部的孔径、功能及固定方式，明确感温元件是否位于该部位；机械安装与电气接点分别定义。
value.en: Use drawings to define metal-end hole dimensions, function and retention. Establish whether the sensing element is at that position, defining mechanical mounting and electrical contacts separately.

value.zh: 按测点、过渡段和仪表区分别选择引线绝缘、保护与固定，确认热源距离、介质暴露和屏蔽安排，不把元件量程当作整条线的耐温。
value.en: Select insulation, protection and retention for sensing, transition and instrument areas. Review heat-source clearance, exposure and shielding; element range does not establish the entire lead temperature capability.

value.zh: 约定接线、电阻与安装检查，以及所需温度比对或校准范围；测量精度由元件、引线、仪表和安装共同验证。
value.en: Agree wiring, resistance and installation checks, plus any temperature-comparison or calibration scope. Verify measurement accuracy across the element, leads, instrument and installation together.

text.zh: 热工设备外围采用温阻测量时，先确定测点位置、元件温区和引线路径。Pt100元件、安装接触与仪表线制共同影响测量结果，外围引线不能按炉内温度直接选型。
text.en: For RTD measurement around thermal equipment, define sensing position, element exposure and lead route. The Pt100 element, mounting contact and instrument wiring scheme all affect the result; select peripheral leads for their own temperature zone rather than the furnace interior.

text.zh: 温控腔体的温阻反馈需按采集模块选择二、三或四线连接，并区分腔内与腔外引线条件。更改线长、接头或接线方式后，重新评估引线电阻与系统验收要求。
text.en: For RTD feedback from controlled chambers, choose two-, three- or four-wire connections to match the acquisition module and distinguish internal from external lead conditions. Changes to lengths, connectors or wiring require a new review of lead resistance and system acceptance.

text.zh: 加热设备的温阻测点需先明确元件位置、安装接触与实际温区，再安排引线过渡和应力支撑。感温段与引线段分别选材，接线与热区保护按温阻通道和仪表要求确认。
text.en: For RTD sensing around heating equipment, define the element position, mounting contact and actual temperature zone before arranging lead transitions and support. Select sensing and lead-section materials separately, and define wiring and thermal protection for the RTD channel and instrument.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备的测温连接需区分感温段、腔体穿出位置和控制端接入。采用温阻输入的项目，按仪表规定线制整理引线与通道；连接器、端接和线长更改后重新确认整条测量链路。
text.en: For commercial heating equipment, distinguish the sensing section, chamber exit and controller entry. In projects using RTD inputs, organize leads and channels for the instrument wiring scheme, and review the full measurement chain after changes to connectors, terminations or length.

title.en: Appliance temperature control and service interfaces

text.zh: 采用温阻传感器的家电项目，可围绕加热或冷却模块安排测温引线及检修接口。先区分感温元件与连接线的供货范围，再确认热区保护、连接表和维护长度。
text.en: For appliance projects using RTDs, route sensing leads and service interfaces around heating or cooling modules. Define whether the sensing element is included with the lead assembly, then confirm thermal-zone protection, the connection map and service lengths.

title.zh: 发动机外围温度监测项目

text.zh: 发动机外围如采用温阻监测，应先定义具体测点和元件温区，结合热源、流体与振动安排引线。线制、接口和安装位置按项目图纸确认，线束结构本身不代表已适配某个发动机或车型。
text.en: For projects using RTDs around an engine, define sensing points and element temperature zones before routing leads around heat sources, fluids and vibration. Confirm wiring scheme, interfaces and mounting from project drawings; harness form alone does not establish fitment to an engine or vehicle.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为围绕温度测点、热区与仪表的连接方向。传感器类型、使用温区及测量验收按具体设备项目确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover temperature sensing points, thermal zones and instruments. Define sensor type, temperature exposure and measurement acceptance for the specific equipment project.

text.zh: 按仪表接法整理二、三或四线连接，明确每个感温元件的引线组、接口位置及通道编号，避免把多测点误接为同一元件。
text.en: Define two-, three- or four-wire connections from the instrument scheme, identifying each element lead group, interface position and channel ID to keep distinct sensing points separate.

text.zh: 按测点与模块位置配置长度、截面、分支和端头；带孔金属部位的用途、安装尺寸与保护方式用图纸确认。
text.en: Configure lengths, conductor size, branches and ends around sensing and module positions. Confirm the function, dimensions and protection of holed metal sections in drawings.

text.zh: 以确认BOM与连接表核对样品，约定引线电阻及安装检查；需要整机温度比对时，再明确元件、仪表、方法和报告的边界。
text.en: Check samples against the approved BOM and connection map, with agreed lead-resistance and installation checks. For system temperature comparisons, define the element, instrument, method and reporting scope separately.

question.zh: 二、三、四线温阻接法能直接互换吗？
question.en: Are two-, three- and four-wire RTD connections interchangeable?

answer.zh: 需与仪表的激励和测量接法匹配。二线读数包含引线影响；三线关注引线匹配；四线分开激励与测量，改接后仍需按整条测量链路验证。
answer.en: Match the instrument excitation and sensing scheme. Two-wire readings include lead effects, three-wire arrangements depend on matching, and four-wire arrangements separate excitation and sensing. Validate the complete chain after changing the connection.

question.zh: 环形金属端部是否就是感温元件？
question.en: Is the ring-shaped metal end the sensing element?

answer.zh: 照片不能说明内部元件位置。需用图纸区分感温安装部位、电气端头和普通固定件，并明确Pt100元件是否随线束一同提供。
answer.en: The photograph does not establish the internal element position. Use drawings to distinguish sensor mounting, electrical ends and ordinary retention, and define whether the Pt100 element is supplied with the harness.

question.zh: 更改引线长度后，精度还能直接沿用吗？
question.en: Can accuracy remain unchanged after altering lead length?

answer.zh: 需要重新评估引线及端接电阻、线制、仪表补偿和安装条件。组件尺寸确认与温度校准分开约定，不能把原元件等级直接当作整条测量链路精度。
answer.en: Review lead and termination resistance, wiring scheme, instrument compensation and installation again. Define dimensional approval separately from temperature calibration; element grade alone does not establish complete-chain accuracy.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 测温连接项目支持

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM项目支持。测温连接先明确传感器与引线供货范围，再按确认材料、连接表和尺寸组织样品；温度比对、校准及完整系统验证的执行范围与报告要求单独约定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. Define sensor and lead supply scope before sampling against approved materials, connection maps and dimensions. Agree temperature comparison, calibration, complete-system validation and reporting scope separately.

title.zh: 从测点与仪表输入开始
title.en: Start with sensing points and instrument inputs

text.zh: 提供传感器及仪表型号、测点温区、连接表、安装方式和目标长度；温阻补充线制，热电偶补充分度、材料与参考接点要求。
text.en: Share sensor and instrument models, sensing temperature zones, connection maps, mounting and target lengths. For RTDs, include the wiring scheme; for thermocouples, include type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

lede.zh: 多段细引线与不同测温接入端头组成线组，可按传感器、仪表及通道分别整理连接。每段的热电偶分度、材料与极性独立确认，不按线组外观默认一致。
lede.en: Several fine leads with different sensing connection ends form a set that can be organized by sensor, instrument and channel. Define each section thermocouple type, materials and polarity separately rather than assuming they match from appearance.

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 多段细引线与不同测温接入端头组成线组，可按传感器、仪表及通道分别整理连接。每段的热电偶分度、材料与极性独立确认，不按线组外观默认一致。
text.en: Several fine leads with different sensing connection ends form a set that can be organized by sensor, instrument and channel. Define each section thermocouple type, materials and polarity separately rather than assuming they match from appearance.

text.zh: 各线段的接口与引线方向可分别安排，端头标签与传感器、采集仪器的通道表使用同一套对应关系。
text.en: Arrange interfaces and lead direction for each section, using one map for end labels, sensors and acquisition-instrument channels.

text.zh: 线组中每段分别说明是探头引线、延长段还是仪表接入段，并按相应分度、材料与参考接点要求确认。
text.en: Identify each section as a probe lead, extension or instrument entry, then define its thermocouple type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

value.zh: 逐段记录热电偶分度、传感器和仪表任务；不同线段的型号、材料与极性分别确认，不凭线组颜色统一认定为K型。
value.en: Record thermocouple type, sensor and instrument task for each section. Confirm part numbers, materials and polarity separately; colors across the set do not establish Type K.

value.zh: 逐端定义正负极、接口位置与测量通道编号，核对连接器触点材料和极性标识采用的规范。
value.en: Define positive and negative leads, interface positions and channel IDs at each end. Confirm connector-contact materials and the convention used for polarity marks.

value.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径按分度与各段温度选择规定材料，不直接用普通铜线替代指定热电偶延长或补偿材料。
value.en: Select specified materials from the measuring junction to the reference junction for the thermocouple type and each temperature zone. Do not directly substitute ordinary copper for specified thermocouple extension or compensating material.

value.zh: 明确异种材料转换位置、参考接点所在温区及仪表的冷端补偿安排；接头、端子排与柜内温差一并纳入测量链路评审。
value.en: Define material-transition locations, the reference-junction temperature zone and the instrument cold-junction compensation arrangement. Include connectors, terminal blocks and cabinet temperature differences in the measurement-chain review.

value.zh: 确认结点位置、露出或护套结构、接地或隔离要求，并与测点接触、响应要求及实际安装结构对应。
value.en: Confirm junction position, exposed or sheathed construction, and grounding or isolation requirements against sensing contact, response needs and the actual installation.

value.zh: 分别定义探头段和延长段长度、材料及温区，确认弯曲、固定和端头防拉扯；编织外观不代表已确认的绝缘材料或温度等级。
value.en: Define lengths, materials and temperature zones separately for probe and extension sections. Confirm bending, supports and strain relief; braided appearance does not establish insulation material or temperature rating.

value.zh: 样品核对物料、极性、连接表与尺寸；如需温度比对或校准，另约定设备、方法、整条测量链路范围与报告责任。
value.en: Check materials, polarity, connection maps and dimensions in the sample. If temperature comparison or calibration is required, agree equipment, method, measurement-chain scope and reporting responsibility separately.

text.zh: 热工设备外围的测温引线需按实际测点温区、热辐射与固定路径选择结构。热电偶分度、结点形式和仪表输入共同定义测量链路，不能把引线绝缘的耐温直接当作探头量程。
text.en: Around thermal equipment, select lead construction from the actual sensing zone, radiant heat and support route. Thermocouple type, junction form and instrument input define the measurement chain; insulation temperature capability does not establish the probe measurement range.

text.zh: 烘炉或温控腔体的测温连接需区分腔内测点、穿出位置与腔外仪表区。按各段温度和接线方式安排延长或补偿材料，把参考接点位置纳入系统记录。
text.en: Temperature connections for furnaces or controlled chambers need separate definitions for the sensing point, cable passage and external instrument area. Select extension or compensating materials for each section and record the reference-junction position within the system.

title.zh: 热电偶探头与局部测点
title.en: Thermocouple probes and local sensing points

text.zh: 热电偶引线可按探头与仪表之间的距离配置，先确认探头分度、接口极性和测点固定，再安排延长段。杆式或细线结点采用的接触方式与使用温区，按具体探头和设备资料定义。
text.en: Configure thermocouple leads for the distance between probe and instrument, confirming probe type, interface polarity and sensing-point retention before planning the extension. Define contact arrangements and temperature zones for stem probes or fine-wire junctions from the specific probe and equipment documents.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备采用热电偶输入时，探头、延长段与温控仪表需保持分度和极性对应。腔体内外的材料转换、参考接点和冷端补偿按设备方案确认，避免把仪表环境温度当作测点温度。
text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. Define material transitions, the reference junction and cold-junction compensation across the chamber boundary from the equipment design, distinguishing instrument ambient temperature from the sensing point.

text.zh: 家电采用热电偶测温的项目，需分别确认传感器、温控模块及可拆接口。引线经过加热区、机壳和维修位置时，各段材料、固定和接点要求按设备资料安排。
text.en: For appliance projects using thermocouples, define the sensor, temperature-control module and removable interfaces separately. Plan materials, retention and junction requirements for leads passing through heated areas, the enclosure and service positions from equipment documents.

title.zh: 发动机外围温度监测项目

text.zh: 发动机外围的热电偶测温项目，需把实际测点、探头结构和引线经过的温区分开定义。按具体分度、接口与固定路径配置连接，并将参考接点和仪表区的热环境纳入验证。
text.en: For thermocouple projects around an engine, define the sensing point, probe construction and temperature zones along the lead separately. Configure the connection for the specified type, interfaces and support route, and include reference-junction and instrument-area thermal conditions in validation.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为围绕温度测点、热区与仪表的连接方向。传感器类型、使用温区及测量验收按具体设备项目确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover temperature sensing points, thermal zones and instruments. Define sensor type, temperature exposure and measurement acceptance for the specific equipment project.

text.zh: 把热电偶分度、延长或补偿材料、端头触点和绝缘分段写入BOM；不同温区的材料边界在装配图中标明。
text.en: Put thermocouple type, extension or compensating materials, end contacts and insulation sections in the BOM. Mark material boundaries across temperature zones in the assembly drawing.

text.zh: 围绕传感器与仪表位置安排线长、端头朝向和标签，使正负极、测点编号与采集通道可逐路核对。
text.en: Set length, end direction and labels around sensor and instrument positions, keeping polarity, sensing-point IDs and acquisition channels traceable in the connection map.

text.zh: 样品先确认结构、物料和接线；参考接点、冷端补偿与温度校准属于整条测量链路的要求，执行范围及记录在项目中约定。
text.en: Confirm structure, materials and wiring at sample review. Treat reference junctions, cold-junction compensation and temperature calibration as measurement-chain requirements, with execution scope and records agreed for the project.

question.zh: 热电偶延长段可以直接换普通铜线吗？
question.en: Can an extension section use ordinary copper wire?

answer.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径需使用与分度及温区相符的规定材料。参考接点之后的连接由仪表设计决定，不能任意在原测量路径中改换铜线。
answer.en: Use the specified materials for the thermocouple type and temperature zones between the measuring and reference junctions. Connections beyond the reference junction follow the instrument design; do not replace sections arbitrarily with copper.

question.zh: 黄色接头是否足以确认K型与正负极？
question.en: Do yellow ends establish Type K and polarity?

answer.zh: 还需核对物料规范、触点材料、极性标识和所用色标规则。外观只帮助识别，不能代替分度与正负极连接表。
answer.en: Also check material specifications, contact materials, polarity marks and the color-code convention. Appearance aids identification but does not replace the thermocouple type and polarity map.

question.zh: 延长线本身是否包含冷端补偿？
question.en: Does an extension lead provide cold-junction compensation?

answer.zh: 延长线负责按规定材料和极性连接。参考接点与冷端补偿由仪表和接线结构定义，需连同传感器、端接和温区共同审核。
answer.en: The lead connects the specified materials with the correct polarity. The instrument and connection arrangement define the reference junction and cold-junction compensation, which need review with the sensor, terminations and temperature zones.

text.zh: 两端设置微型插接端头，便于把测温延长段作为独立线段安排安装和拆卸。对插与极性按完整接口资料确认。
text.en: Miniature mating ends let the temperature extension be arranged as a removable section. Define mating and polarity from complete interface documents.

text.zh: 两端之间是一段连续细线，可围绕传感器到仪表的位置安排长度、固定和端头后方的弯曲空间。
text.en: A continuous fine-cable section links the ends. Set length, supports and bends behind the ends around sensor and instrument positions.

text.zh: 连接器触点与线材材料需一起纳入热电偶链路定义，避免只确认端头外形而遗漏材料转换和参考接点。
text.en: Define connector-contact and cable materials together within the thermocouple chain, including material transitions and the reference junction as well as end form.

value.zh: 记录热电偶分度、传感器与仪表输入资料，区分探头引线、延长线与补偿段。K型项目按对应材料体系定义，不以黄色外观单独认定。
value.en: Record thermocouple type and sensor and instrument-input documents. Distinguish probe leads, extension leads and compensating sections. Use the matching material system for Type K; yellow appearance alone does not identify it.

text.zh: 发动机外围的热电偶测温项目，需把实际测点、探头结构和引线经过的温区分开定义。按具体分度、接口与固定路径配置连接，并将参考接点和仪表区的热环境纳入验证。
text.en: For thermocouple projects around an engine, define the sensing point, probe construction and temperature zones along the lead separately. Configure the connection for the specified type, interfaces and support route, and include reference-junction and instrument-area thermal conditions in validation.

applicationsIntro.zh: 以下为围绕温度测点、热区与仪表的连接方向。传感器类型、使用温区及测量验收按具体设备项目确认。
applicationsIntro.en: These directions cover temperature sensing points, thermal zones and instruments. Define sensor type, temperature exposure and measurement acceptance for the specific equipment project.

text.zh: 把热电偶分度、延长或补偿材料、端头触点和绝缘分段写入BOM；不同温区的材料边界在装配图中标明。
text.en: Put thermocouple type, extension or compensating materials, end contacts and insulation sections in the BOM. Mark material boundaries across temperature zones in the assembly drawing.

text.zh: 围绕传感器与仪表位置安排线长、端头朝向和标签，使正负极、测点编号与采集通道可逐路核对。
text.en: Set length, end direction and labels around sensor and instrument positions, keeping polarity, sensing-point IDs and acquisition channels traceable in the connection map.

text.zh: 样品先确认结构、物料和接线；参考接点、冷端补偿与温度校准属于整条测量链路的要求，执行范围及记录在项目中约定。
text.en: Confirm structure, materials and wiring at sample review. Treat reference junctions, cold-junction compensation and temperature calibration as measurement-chain requirements, with execution scope and records agreed for the project.

question.zh: 热电偶延长段可以直接换普通铜线吗？
question.en: Can an extension section use ordinary copper wire?

answer.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径需使用与分度及温区相符的规定材料。参考接点之后的连接由仪表设计决定，不能任意在原测量路径中改换铜线。
answer.en: Use the specified materials for the thermocouple type and temperature zones between the measuring and reference junctions. Connections beyond the reference junction follow the instrument design; do not replace sections arbitrarily with copper.

question.zh: 黄色接头是否足以确认K型与正负极？
question.en: Do yellow ends establish Type K and polarity?

answer.zh: 还需核对物料规范、触点材料、极性标识和所用色标规则。外观只帮助识别，不能代替分度与正负极连接表。
answer.en: Also check material specifications, contact materials, polarity marks and the color-code convention. Appearance aids identification but does not replace the thermocouple type and polarity map.

question.zh: 延长线本身是否包含冷端补偿？
question.en: Does an extension lead provide cold-junction compensation?

answer.zh: 延长线负责按规定材料和极性连接。参考接点与冷端补偿由仪表和接线结构定义，需连同传感器、端接和温区共同审核。
answer.en: The lead connects the specified materials with the correct polarity. The instrument and connection arrangement define the reference junction and cold-junction compensation, which need review with the sensor, terminations and temperature zones.

title.zh: 中国工厂 · 测温连接项目支持

text.zh: Super Smile-Tech中国工厂提供定制线束制造及OEM/ODM项目支持。测温连接先明确传感器与引线供货范围，再按确认材料、连接表和尺寸组织样品；温度比对、校准及完整系统验证的执行范围与报告要求单独约定。
text.en: Our China factory provides custom wire harness manufacturing and OEM/ODM project support. Define sensor and lead supply scope before sampling against approved materials, connection maps and dimensions. Agree temperature comparison, calibration, complete-system validation and reporting scope separately.

title.zh: 从测点与仪表输入开始
title.en: Start with sensing points and instrument inputs

text.zh: 提供传感器及仪表型号、测点温区、连接表、安装方式和目标长度；温阻补充线制，热电偶补充分度、材料与参考接点要求。
text.en: Share sensor and instrument models, sensing temperature zones, connection maps, mounting and target lengths. For RTDs, include the wiring scheme; for thermocouples, include type, materials and reference-junction requirements.

lede.zh: 细线端部的小结点与另一端微型插接头组成测温探头连接形式，可围绕局部测点安排接触和引线路径。结点结构、极性及温区按项目要求确认。
lede.en: A small junction at the fine-wire end and a miniature plug form a temperature-probe connection for local sensing and lead routing. Confirm junction construction, polarity and temperature zones for the project.

structureIntro.zh: 把感温元件、引线与仪表作为同一测量链路考虑；以下区分可见连接形式与需在项目中定义的测量配置。
structureIntro.en: Consider the sensing element, leads and instrument as one measurement chain, separating the visible connection form from measurement configuration defined for the project.

text.zh: 一端可见微型插接头，出线方向与插拔空间可结合仪表端口安排；正负极以接头资料和接线表核对。
text.en: A miniature plug is visible at one end. Arrange cable exit and mating clearance around the instrument port, checking polarity from connector documents and the wiring map.

text.zh: 细线另一端可见小结点，结点固定与测点接触需要避免拉力直接作用于细线接合部位。
text.en: A small junction is visible at the fine-wire end. Arrange contact and retention so installation loads do not act directly on the fine-wire joint.

text.zh: 细线段有外层保护纹理，实际材料、覆盖范围和温度条件按物料文件定义，再安排热区与仪表区之间的过渡。
text.en: The fine cable has a textured protective outer layer. Define its material, coverage and temperature conditions from material documents before arranging the transition between sensing and instrument zones.

label.zh: 热电偶分度与接入任务

value.zh: 记录热电偶分度、传感器与仪表输入资料，区分探头引线、延长线与补偿段。K型项目按对应材料体系定义，不以黄色外观单独认定。
value.en: Record thermocouple type and sensor and instrument-input documents. Distinguish probe leads, extension leads and compensating sections. Use the matching material system for Type K; yellow appearance alone does not identify it.

value.zh: 逐端定义正负极、接口位置与测量通道编号，核对连接器触点材料和极性标识采用的规范。
value.en: Define positive and negative leads, interface positions and channel IDs at each end. Confirm connector-contact materials and the convention used for polarity marks.

value.zh: 从测温结点到参考接点的路径按分度与各段温度选择规定材料，不直接用普通铜线替代指定热电偶延长或补偿材料。
value.en: Select specified materials from the measuring junction to the reference junction for the thermocouple type and each temperature zone. Do not directly substitute ordinary copper for specified thermocouple extension or compensating material.

value.zh: 明确异种材料转换位置、参考接点所在温区及仪表的冷端补偿安排；接头、端子排与柜内温差一并纳入测量链路评审。
value.en: Define material-transition locations, the reference-junction temperature zone and the instrument cold-junction compensation arrangement. Include connectors, terminal blocks and cabinet temperature differences in the measurement-chain review.

value.zh: 确认结点位置、露出或护套结构、接地或隔离要求，并与测点接触、响应要求及实际安装结构对应。
value.en: Confirm junction position, exposed or sheathed construction, and grounding or isolation requirements against sensing contact, response needs and the actual installation.

value.zh: 分别定义探头段和延长段长度、材料及温区，确认弯曲、固定和端头防拉扯；编织外观不代表已确认的绝缘材料或温度等级。
value.en: Define lengths, materials and temperature zones separately for probe and extension sections. Confirm bending, supports and strain relief; braided appearance does not establish insulation material or temperature rating.

value.zh: 样品核对物料、极性、连接表与尺寸；如需温度比对或校准，另约定设备、方法、整条测量链路范围与报告责任。
value.en: Check materials, polarity, connection maps and dimensions in the sample. If temperature comparison or calibration is required, agree equipment, method, measurement-chain scope and reporting responsibility separately.

text.zh: 热工设备外围的测温引线需按实际测点温区、热辐射与固定路径选择结构。热电偶分度、结点形式和仪表输入共同定义测量链路，不能把引线绝缘的耐温直接当作探头量程。
text.en: Around thermal equipment, select lead construction from the actual sensing zone, radiant heat and support route. Thermocouple type, junction form and instrument input define the measurement chain; insulation temperature capability does not establish the probe measurement range.

text.zh: 烘炉或温控腔体的测温连接需区分腔内测点、穿出位置与腔外仪表区。按各段温度和接线方式安排延长或补偿材料，把参考接点位置纳入系统记录。
text.en: Temperature connections for furnaces or controlled chambers need separate definitions for the sensing point, cable passage and external instrument area. Select extension or compensating materials for each section and record the reference-junction position within the system.

title.zh: 热电偶探头与局部测点
title.en: Thermocouple probes and local sensing points

text.zh: 热电偶引线可按探头与仪表之间的距离配置，先确认探头分度、接口极性和测点固定，再安排延长段。杆式或细线结点采用的接触方式与使用温区，按具体探头和设备资料定义。
text.en: Configure thermocouple leads for the distance between probe and instrument, confirming probe type, interface polarity and sensing-point retention before planning the extension. Define contact arrangements and temperature zones for stem probes or fine-wire junctions from the specific probe and equipment documents.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备采用热电偶输入时，探头、延长段与温控仪表需保持分度和极性对应。腔体内外的材料转换、参考接点和冷端补偿按设备方案确认，避免把仪表环境温度当作测点温度。
text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. Define material transitions, the reference junction and cold-junction compensation across the chamber boundary from the equipment design, distinguishing instrument ambient temperature from the sensing point.

text.zh: 家电采用热电偶测温的项目，需分别确认传感器、温控模块及可拆接口。引线经过加热区、机壳和维修位置时，各段材料、固定和接点要求按设备资料安排。
text.en: For appliance projects using thermocouples, define the sensor, temperature-control module and removable interfaces separately. Plan materials, retention and junction requirements for leads passing through heated areas, the enclosure and service positions from equipment documents.
